jobs.title: Global Procurement Manager - Contract Manufacturing

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire des achats mondiaux - Fabrication de contrats

jobs.description:
Location: La Tour-de-Peilz, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and feel trusted to make decisions that matter.

As a Global Procurement Manager for Contract Manufacturing at Nestlé Global Procurement, your mission is to lead the commercial and sourcing activities for the global Contract Manufacturing category. Reporting to the Global Category Lead, you will define and implement category strategies, drive strategic sourcing initiatives, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver value, optimize supplier performance, and support business growth.

We operate on a truly global scale, bringing together over 40 nationalities across three dynamic hubs in Switzerland, Panama, and Malaysia. This is your chance to drive innovation, sustainability, and impact at scale, ensuring value creation through responsibly sourced supply across diverse categories.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Procurement Manager - Contract Manufacturing

• Represent Procurement in cross-functional business projects, including new product launches, geographical expansions, cost improvement initiatives, supplier transitions, and business continuity planning.

• Lead strategic relationships with contract manufacturers, driving sustainable performance, innovation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Manage end-to-end sourcing activities for new product launches, from supplier scouting and selection to commercial negotiations and contract execution.

• Develop deep market intelligence and expertise on the global contract manufacturing landscape relevant to the business portfolio.

• Deliver cost reduction targets while ensuring high levels of supplier performance, quality, and service continuity.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to align sourcing strategies with growth objectives, operational needs, and supply security.

What will make you successful

• Well established experience in procurement, delivering competitive advantage through strategic sourcing within multi-country environments.

• Solid experience in the development and execution of sourcing strategies, leveraging expertise in supplier risk management, responsible sourcing, and commercial negotiations.

• Proven track record in managing supplier relationships and development programs.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams by representing procurement effectively and fostering collaboration across a complex global organization.

• Fluency in English, another language will be an asset.

At Nestlé Global Procurement, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and feel trusted to make decisions that matter.

#Nestradecareer

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: La Tour-de-Peilz, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Essere una forza per il bene e sentirsi fidati di prendere decisioni che importa.

In qualità di Global Procurement Manager for Contract Manufacturing presso Nestlé Global Procurement, la vostra missione è quella di guidare le attività commerciali e sourcing per la categoria Global Contract Manufacturing. Segnalando al Global Categoria Lead, definirai e implementerai strategie di categoria, guiderai iniziative strategiche di approvvigionamento e collaborerai con stakeholder interfunzionali per fornire valore, ottimizzare le prestazioni dei fornitori e sostenere la crescita aziendale.

Operiamo su scala mondiale, mettendo insieme oltre 40 nazionalità in tre hub dinamici in Svizzera, Panama e Malesia. Questa è la tua occasione per guidare l'innovazione, la sostenibilità e l'impatto su scala, assicurando la creazione di valore attraverso la fornitura responsabile attraverso diverse categorie.

Come farai un impatto come Global Procurement Manager - Contract Manufacturing

• Rappresentare il Procurement in progetti aziendali interfunzionali, tra cui nuovi lancio di prodotti, espansioni geografiche, iniziative di miglioramento dei costi, transizioni dei fornitori e pianificazione della continuità aziendale.

• Leader relazioni strategiche con i produttori di contratti, guidando iniziative di performance sostenibili, innovazione e miglioramento continuo.

• Gestisci le attività di sourcing end-to-end per i nuovi lanci di prodotto, dalla scouting dei fornitori e dalla selezione ai negoziati commerciali e l'esecuzione dei contratti.

• Sviluppare un'intelligenza e un'esperienza di mercato profonde sul panorama globale della produzione di contratti rilevanti per il portafoglio business.

• Fornire obiettivi di riduzione dei costi, garantendo elevati livelli di prestazioni, qualità e continuità di servizio.

• Collabora con gli stakeholder aziendali per allineare le strategie di approvvigionamento con gli obiettivi di crescita, le esigenze operative e la sicurezza di approvvigionamento.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Esperienza ben consolidata negli appalti, offrendo un vantaggio competitivo attraverso un approvvigionamento strategico all'interno di ambienti multi-paese.

• Esperienza solida nello sviluppo e nell'esecuzione di strategie di approvvigionamento, sfruttando le competenze nella gestione dei rischi dei fornitori, nell'assistenza responsabile e nei negoziati commerciali.

• Provato record di traccia nella gestione delle relazioni dei fornitori e dei programmi di sviluppo.

• Capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senior e i team interfunzionali rappresentando l'approvvigionamento in modo efficace e promuovendo la collaborazione in un'organizzazione globale complessa.

• Fluency in inglese, un'altra lingua sarà un bene.

Al Nestlé Global Procurement, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

Bereit, mit uns zu wachsen?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und wachsen Sie durch Erfahrungen, die Sie weiter vorantreiben.

Soyez une force pour le bien et développez à travers des expériences qui vous poussent plus loin.

Dans cette opportunité interne chez Nestlé Suisse, votre mission est de construire et de piloter la stratégie de marque et de portefeuille MAGGI pour rajeunir la marque et doubler sa taille sur le marché suisse. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec des équipes à travers le marketing, les ventes, le développement des clients, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les finances, les communications d'entreprise, le commerce électronique, les équipes de marques régionales et les partenaires de l'agence. C'est l'occasion pour vous de prendre en main, de développer votre expertise et de faire une différence à l'échelle.

Comment vous aurez un impact en tant que leader commercial de marque MAGGI

• Piloter la stratégie de marque et de portefeuille MAGGI pour accélérer la croissance, renforcer les actions de marque et élargir l'impact sur le marché suisse.

• Identifier les possibilités de consommation les plus attrayantes et transformer les idées en expériences de marque qui renforcent la pertinence et la loyauté à long terme.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide expertise en stratégie de marque et une compréhension claire de la façon d'accroître la performance de la marque, les capitaux propres et la valeur du portefeuille.

• Appliquer les connaissances des consommateurs et du marché pour façonner des stratégies efficaces d'innovation, de rénovation et d'activation.

• L'utilisation d'un sens commercial et financier pour gérer les performances de la marque, optimiser les investissements et traduire les priorités en résultats.

• Collaborer efficacement entre les fonctions et avec des partenaires externes tout en dirigeant, développant et stimulant une équipe hautement performante.

• Communiquer avec les compétences de travail en anglais et en allemand ou en anglais et en français.

• Démontrer courage, collaboration, rapidité et apprentissage continu.

Chez Nestlé, nous nous soucions de notre peuple.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime fondée sur les performances

• Contribution aux soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte contribution de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sécuritaire pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue vidéo avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents est établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Prêt à grandir avec nous ?

Appliquer maintenant et grandir à travers des expériences qui vous poussent plus loin.

jobs.title: Global SHE Lead
jobs.description:
Location: La Tour-de-Peilz, Switzerland

Work model : Full-Time Act. Rate 100%

Contract type / duration: Permanent contract

Together, we make breakfast better.

As a Global SHE Lead at CPW, your mission is to lead and strengthen our Safety, Health and Environment strategy across our factories, distribution centers and Head Offices. You will make a difference by working closely with local SHE teams, factory leadership, and internal and external stakeholders. This is your opportunity to make breakfast better and help people start their day in the best possible way.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global SHE Lead

• Embed safety as a core leadership value by strengthening accountability and ensuring SHE is fully integrated into daily decision-making and operational routines.

• Drive SHE cultural transformation at shopfloor level by elevating frontline leadership behaviours through targeted coaching, and impactful communication.

• Deploy global SHE standards across CPW factories, ensuring consistency while enabling local ownership and high-performing safety cultures.

• Strengthen risk management and resilience by driving robust audit frameworks and proactive prevention plans to reduce operational risks.

• Build sustainable capability by developing factory leaders and SHE professionals, reinforcing expertise, mindset and long-term compliance.

• Accelerate continuous improvement by identifying, sharing and scaling best practices and innovative solutions across sites.

• Influence business performance by partnering cross-functionally to elevate SHE outcomes and support safe, sustainable operations.

What will make you successful

• Bringing proven experience in Safety within complex industrial environments, with a strong track record in driving safety culture transformation. Experience operating and influencing across regional or global organizations is a plus, while hands-on leadership experience at shopfloor level remains a strong advantage.

• Strong expertise in SHE management systems, auditing and risk management, complemented by recognized safety certifications (e.g., NEBOSH, ISO Lead Auditor or equivalent).

• Highly effective stakeholder influencer, able to engage, challenge and align leaders across functions, geographies and levels of the organization.

• Clear and impactful communicator, fluent in English (French is a plus), capable of connecting with audiences from shopfloor teams to senior leadership.

• Role model of CPW values, demonstrating collaboration, commitment, courage and capability in driving business and people outcomes.

At CPW, collaboration and purpose drive everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Ready to help make breakfast better for millions around the world?
Apply now and help people start their day in the best possible way.

jobs.title: Brand Experience Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: La Tour-de-Peilz, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Brand Experience Specialist at Nestlé Suisse S.A., your mission is to rejuvenate THOMY and deepen consumer loyalty by delivering integrated brand experiences that strengthen emotional connection and drive sustainable growth. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with marketing, sales, communications, food-service teams, agencies and sponsorship partners. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Brand Experience Specialist

• Turning consumer, cultural and category insights into compelling brand experiences that grow brand relevance and commercial impact.

• Shaping an omnichannel activation strategy that creates a seamless THOMY experience across the OOH / convenience channel.

• Activating an external network to build high-value local sponsorship partnerships that expand visibility, strengthen brand meaning and unlock sustainable growth.

• Developing and executing brand activations, live marketing events and brand experiences that convert participation into lasting loyalty, engagement and advocacy.

• Delivering integrated amplification plans that connect every activation to brand priorities and measurable business outcomes.

• Driving excellent execution through clear collaboration, smart resource allocation and continuous learning from results.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in brand marketing, consumer activation, communications, or shopper marketing, while acting as a passionate ambassador for THOMY both internally and externally.

• Applying Out-of-Home market knowledge to deliver integrated omnichannel activations that strengthen brand visibility and drive business results across the region, supported by the flexibility to travel regularly and a valid driver's license.

• Using consumer insights, performance metrics, and budget management expertise to optimize execution, measure effectiveness, and maximize return on investment.

• Collaborating effectively with agencies, external partners, and cross-functional teams while leading projects from brief to successful implementation.

• Communicating fluently in Swiss German/German and English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed, and continuous learning.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to a fair and transparent internal hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: La Tour-de-Peilz, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Essere una forza per il bene e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre

In qualità di Brand Experience Specialist presso Nestlé Suisse S.A., la vostra missione è di ringiovanire THOMY e approfondire la lealtà dei consumatori offrendo esperienze di brand integrate che rafforzano la connessione emotiva e spingono la crescita sostenibile. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con marketing, vendite, comunicazioni, team di food-service, agenzie e partner di sponsorizzazione. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fare la differenza in scala.

Come farete un impatto come specialista di Brand Experience

• Trasformando intuizioni di consumatori, culturali e di categoria in esperienze di marca convincenti che crescono la rilevanza del marchio e l'impatto commerciale.

• Definire una strategia di attivazione omnicanale che crea un'esperienza di THOMY senza soluzione di continuità attraverso il canale OOH / convenienza.

• Attivare una rete esterna per costruire partnership di sponsorizzazione locali di alto valore che espandono la visibilità, rafforzino il significato del marchio e sbloccano la crescita sostenibile.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire le attivazioni del marchio, eventi di marketing dal vivo e le esperienze del marchio che convertono la partecipazione in una duratura fedeltà, impegno e advocacy.

• Fornire piani di amplificazione integrati che collegano ogni attivazione alle priorità del marchio e risultati aziendali misurabili.

• Guidare l'esecuzione eccellente attraverso una collaborazione chiara, allocazione intelligente delle risorse e apprendimento continuo dai risultati.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portando una forte esperienza nel marketing del marchio, nell'attivazione dei consumatori, nelle comunicazioni o nel marketing degli shopper, agendo come ambasciatore appassionato di THOMY sia internamente che esternamente.

• Applicando conoscenze di mercato Out-of-Home per fornire attivazioni omnichannel integrate che rafforzano la visibilità del marchio e i risultati aziendali di guida in tutta la regione, supportato dalla flessibilità di viaggiare regolarmente e dalla valida licenza del conducente.

• Utilizzando le conoscenze dei consumatori, le metriche delle prestazioni e le competenze di gestione del bilancio per ottimizzare l'esecuzione, misurare l'efficacia e massimizzare il ritorno sugli investimenti.

• Collaborare efficacemente con le agenzie, i partner esterni e i team interfunzionali, mentre i progetti principali da breve a successo implementazione.

• Comunicare fluentemente in tedesco / tedesco svizzero e inglese.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Ci impegniamo a un processo di assunzione interno equo e trasparente e assicuriamo che tutte le applicazioni siano trattate con riservatezza.

La tua applicazione in genere includerà una recensione iniziale, conversazioni con Talent Acquisition e il team di assunzione, seguita da una discussione finale.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronti a crescere con noi?

Applicare ora e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre.

Être une force pour le bien et accélérer le changement qui améliore les vies et la planète.

En tant que responsable mondial de la communication médicale chez Nestlé Nutrition et Santé, votre mission est de façonner la communication mondiale, centrée sur les professionnels de la santé, pour le portefeuille de vitamines, minéraux et suppléments premium, traduisant la dernière science en engagements convaincants de marque et non-marqués qui soutiennent les produits nouveaux et existants. Vous ferez la différence en collaborant étroitement avec le marketing, les affaires réglementaires et scientifiques, les sciences de la nutrition, la recherche et le développement, les équipes régionales et commerciales, les agences externes, les partenaires de recherche et les experts scientifiques. C'est l'occasion pour vous de prendre en main, de développer votre expertise et de faire une différence à l'échelle.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que responsable mondial de la communication médicale

• Élaborer des plans mondiaux d'engagement et de communication qui renforcent la compréhension des professionnels de la santé et accroissent les recommandations, les activités de plaidoyer et l'adoption dans le portefeuille de vitamines, minéraux et suppléments premium.

• Créer des documents de communication scientifique convaincants sur les canaux personnels, numériques et sociaux pour appuyer les lancements de nouveaux produits et les concepts de produits établis.

• Élaborer des initiatives de sensibilisation au marché qui renforcent la crédibilité scientifique et soutiennent la croissance durable du portefeuille.

• Diriger les programmes mondiaux, les activités de congrès, les tables rondes et les engagements consultatifs de marque et non de marque qui approfondissent les relations de confiance avec les professionnels de la santé.

• Collaborer avec les équipes mondiales, régionales et commerciales pour fournir des outils de communication pertinents, cohérents et prêts à être adoptés au niveau local.

• Établir des partenariats productifs avec des experts scientifiques et des leaders d'opinion clés, des organismes et des partenaires de recherche pour transformer les connaissances et les données probantes en un engagement significatif.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une expérience importante en marketing médical dans la nutrition, les produits pharmaceutiques ou les environnements de santé des consommateurs.

• Appliquer la sensibilisation scientifique et réglementaire, y compris la connaissance des lignes directrices et des règlements externes pertinents pour les professionnels de la santé et les relations de plaidoyer pour développer des programmes et matériels crédibles de professionnels de la santé de marque et non de marque.

• L'utilisation de la planification stratégique, de l'analyse des données et du leadership de projet pour faire passer plusieurs priorités de la perspicacité à l'action, l'expérience mondiale étant très privilégiée.

• Collaborer avec influence et intégrité entre les équipes mondiales tout en établissant des relations internes et externes de confiance.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais.

• Démontrer courage, collaboration, rapidité et apprentissage continu.

Chez Nestlé Nutrition et Santé, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Une forte contribution de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. jobs.title: Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
Position snapshot

Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland

Company: Nestlé Research Konolfingen

Act. Rate: 80-100%

Type of contract: Permanent contract

Language: Fluent in English (B2 or better) and German (an advantage)

What we offer at Nestlé

Flexible work policies in terms of core hours. Please talk to us during the recruitment process about what flexibility could look like for you!

Genuine opportunities for career and personal development

Working in an international environment with the possibility to work worldwide after a successful experience in Konolfingen

Attractive additional benefits

Position summary

Our Nestlé Research and Development Center in Konolfingen (NRDK), Switzerland, develops for Nestlé worldwide, new products, processes and packaging concepts in the areas of Milk, plant-based and Nutrition products. This includes various process and filling technologies for liquid, powder or sterile products. In addition, it also provides technical assistance and engineering support for major Capital Investment Projects (CAPEX) to our factories.

As a member of our local Site-Engineering team you will support with your technical expertise and in close collaboration with your colleagues the daily pilot plant operations as well as the evaluation, design and implementation of local investment projects.

We offer a dynamic, inclusive, and international working environment with many opportunities across different companies, functions, and regions. Don’t miss the opportunity to join us and work with different teams in an agile and diverse context.

Daily activities of an Engineering Specialist

• Prepare high-level feasibility studies by asking the right questions to get a broad picture without going into too many details for new process and product ideas

• Prepare projects in further details to submit budget requests taking in account the various internal and external stakeholders of the NRDK

• Lead and execute the projects on site safely and in close collaboration with the various team members and specific operational functions leading to a successful commissioning, start-up and documented handover

• Assist our technicians/operators in troubleshooting and more complex root cause analysis on site

• Help to improve the asset intensity of our pilot plant and production facilities with detailed data analysis and specific process know-how

• Develop and drive sustainable solutions to meet our net zero goal by challenging and improving the status-quo

• Support the exploration and development of new technologies/products and help to qualify and industrialize them

What will make you successful

• Engineering degree (preferably process or mechanical engineering)

• Experience in process engineering and food industry including hygienic requirements are an advantage but not a must

• Excellent networking and communication skills

• End to end (E2E)-mindset (start projects with a clearly defined and well aligned scope ending up in successful handover including proper documentation)

• Passionate about making a difference in the professional environment

• Strong problem-solving skills as part of a bigger team and willing to apply them also in the field

• Full commitment to compliance (legal, safety, quality, finance) for all activities

• Willingness to develop specific expertise in defined areas to be the local subject matter expert

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference. We do this by fostering a diverse, friendly, supportive, and collaborative environment, that creates positive disruption, embraces innovation, and empowers people and teams to win.
We aim to hire friendly, respectful, inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.
Be a force for good. Join Nestlé and visit us on www.nestle.com.

jobs.description:

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As a Recipe Formulation Specialist IF & Toddler, your mission is to drive the product recipe lifecycle from new product brief to launch, ensuring compliant formulation, effective recipe management and ingredient specification excellence. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with operations, quality, manufacturing, product, research and development, regulatory and medical affairs teams across markets and factories. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Recipe Formulation Specialist IF & Toddler

• Lead compliant recipe development from product brief to launch, ensuring scientifically robust formulations across categories, factories, and markets.

• Translate formulation science into fit-for-purpose recipes by integrating ingredient functionality, nutrient targets, process losses, shelf-life evolution, and manufacturing feasibility.

• Embed compliance by design throughout innovation and renovation projects, ensuring validation, approvals, and documentation align with category rules, internal standards, and external requirements.

• Build technical capability by sharing formulation expertise, best practices, standards, and training with recipe and ingredient specialists, Product Developers, CTAGs, AGs, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Provide technical decision support through formulation proposals, trade-off assessments, variability analyses, and proactive risk mitigation across ingredients, quality, regulatory, nutrition, and manufacturing dimensions.

• Drive simplification and harmonization of recipes, ingredients, and specifications to reduce portfolio complexity, improve operational efficiency, and support scale-up or transfer activities.

• Be a force for continuous improvements by challenging existing practices and processes, improving existing tools, tracking and reporting to increase portfolio visibility.

• Safeguard business continuity by maintaining approval readiness, monitoring formulation-related KPIs, and responding effectively to compliance, data, or recipe management challenges.

What will make you successful

• Scientific education in Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Pharmacist or a related field, combined with strong hands-on experience in recipe formulation, compliance, and management of nutritional or food products.

• Using analytical thinking, problem solving and digital tools to manage recipe data, good knowledge of statistical calculations.

• Solid understanding of ingredient contributions, process and shelf-life losses, manufacturing feasibility, and the regulatory environment, with the ability to translate these factors into compliant and robust recipe solutions.

• Experience working in cross-functional teams and strong proficiency in relevant systems and digital tools, including SAP-RM and an understanding of DevEX and CAT, together with excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Communicating fluently in English.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. • Partner with laboratory stakeholders. data domain owners, lab business analysts together with data architects and engineers to translate functional requirements into scalable, and well-documented technical solutions, ensuring alignment between scientific workflows and technological capabilities

• Enable new and existing laboratory instruments end to end, from understanding the scientific workflow and data outputs to defining and establishing connectivity and data flow (LIMS, robotics, automation platforms, downstream systems), in collaboration with IT network, security specialists

• Collaborate with internal and external professionals to propose and implement customizations to lab digital platforms used (LIMS, instrument integration, technology specific data processing, metadata capture) in view of efficiency, quality, traceability, and governance by design

• Identify opportunities to increase value of lab data gathered across different sources by leveraging data technologies (data integrations, data warehousing, automated data quality checks, etc)

• Solid grasp of the lab solutions ecosystem: ELN, CDS, LES, multi-omics pipelines, IoT-connected equipment, barcode systems, etc.

• Enabling AI/ML and analytics use cases on scientific data

• Strong problem-solving and hands-on mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience collaborating with external vendors and data professionals and driving delivery through others

• Ability to work in cross-functional and international teams

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills

• Fluent spoken and written English

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Lab Data Technology Specialist at Nestlé Research within our Computational Sciences department, you will be responsible for reinforcing our laboratory data foundations to help unlock the full value of the data generated by our scientific instruments and laboratory systems. Sitting at the intersection of science, laboratory data, and modern data engineering, you will leverage latest data technologies and AI for coding tools to transform raw, heterogeneous scientific data into trusted, well-documented, and reusable data assets that accelerate impactful scientific research.

How you’ll make an impact as a Lab Data Technology Specialist

• Partner with laboratory stakeholders. data domain owners, lab business analysts together with data architects and engineers to translate functional requirements into scalable, and well-documented technical solutions, ensuring alignment between scientific workflows and technological capabilities

• Enable new and existing laboratory instruments end to end, from understanding the scientific workflow and data outputs to defining and establishing connectivity and data flow (LIMS, robotics, automation platforms, downstream systems), in collaboration with IT network, security specialists

• Collaborate with internal and external professionals to propose and implement customizations to lab digital platforms used (LIMS, instrument integration, technology specific data processing, metadata capture) in view of efficiency, quality, traceability, and governance by design

• Identify opportunities to increase value of lab data gathered across different sources by leveraging data technologies (data integrations, data warehousing, automated data quality checks, etc)

• Support testing, deployment, change management, and continuous improvement of compliant, scalable lab solutions, including AI-enabled opportunities to strengthen data flows and unlock value from lab data

What will make you successful

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or computational discipline (e.g., Chemistry, life sciences, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Data Engineering, Computer Science), or equivalent experience.

• Solid experience in applying data engineering to scientific, laboratory data

• Required technical skills

•

• LIMS customization, data models, and integration.

• Integrating lab instruments, applications, robots, and IoT with reference databases and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake).

• Solid grasp of the lab solutions ecosystem: ELN, CDS, LES, multi-omics pipelines, IoT-connected equipment, barcode systems, etc.

• Programming (e.g., Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Data engineering and modeling — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), APIs, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — with engineering rigor (Git, CI/CD, testing, data quality, observability, reproducibility).

• Nice-to-have technical skills

• Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).

• FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling

• Enabling AI/ML and analytics use cases on scientific data

• Domain exposure in chemistry, biology, food, or omics

• Reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage

• Leveraging Agentic AI to automate data engineering activities

• Required non-technical skills

• Strong problem-solving and hands-on mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience collaborating with external vendors and data professionals and driving delivery through others

• Ability to work in cross-functional and international teams

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills

• Fluent spoken and written English

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Lieu: Lausanne, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Hybride / Temps plein 100%

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

En tant que spécialiste de la technologie des données de laboratoire chez Nestlé Research au sein de notre département des Sciences Computationnelles, vous serez chargé de renforcer nos bases de données de laboratoire pour aider à débloquer toute la valeur des données générées par nos instruments scientifiques et nos systèmes de laboratoire. Assis à l'intersection de la science, des données de laboratoire et de l'ingénierie moderne des données, vous tirerez parti des dernières technologies de données et de l'IA pour coder des outils permettant de transformer des données scientifiques brutes et hétérogènes en données fiables, bien documentées et réutilisables qui accélèrent la recherche scientifique.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste de la technologie des données de laboratoire

• Partenaire avec les intervenants du laboratoire. propriétaires de domaines de données, analystes d'affaires de laboratoire, architectes de données et ingénieurs pour traduire les exigences fonctionnelles en solutions techniques évolutives et bien documentées, assurant l'alignement entre les flux de travail scientifiques et les capacités technologiques

• Permettre aux nouveaux et existants instruments de laboratoire de se terminer, de la compréhension du flux de travail scientifique et des sorties de données à la définition et à l'établissement de la connectivité et du flux de données (LIMS, robotique, plateformes d'automatisation, systèmes en aval), en collaboration avec le réseau informatique, les spécialistes de la sécurité

• Collaborer avec des professionnels internes et externes pour proposer et mettre en œuvre des personnalisations aux plateformes numériques de laboratoire utilisées (LIMS, intégration d'instruments, traitement de données spécifiques à la technologie, capture de métadonnées) en vue de l'efficacité, de la qualité, de la traçabilité et de la gouvernance par la conception

• Déterminer les possibilités d'accroître la valeur des données de laboratoire recueillies dans différentes sources en tirant parti des technologies de données (intégration des données, entreposage des données, contrôle automatisé de la qualité des données, etc.)

• Soutenir les essais, le déploiement, la gestion du changement et l'amélioration continue des solutions de laboratoire adaptables et évolutives, y compris les possibilités permettant de renforcer les flux de données et de débloquer la valeur des données de laboratoire

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences ou en informatique (p. ex. chimie, sciences de la vie, bioinformatique, chimie, génie des données, informatique) ou expérience équivalente.

• Une solide expérience dans l'application de l'ingénierie des données aux données scientifiques et de laboratoire

• Compétences techniques requises

•

• Personnalisation LIMS, modèles de données et intégration.

• Intégrer les instruments de laboratoire, les applications, les robots et l'IdO avec les bases de données de référence et les entrepôts de données (p. ex., Snowflake).

• Une bonne compréhension de l'écosystème des solutions de laboratoire : ELN, CDS, ERP, pipelines multi-omiques, équipements connectés à l'IoT, systèmes de codes à barres, etc.

• Programmation (p. ex. Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Ingénierie et modélisation des données — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), API, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — avec rigueur technique (Git, CI/CD, test, qualité des données, observabilité, reproductibilité).

• Bonnes compétences techniques

• Modélisation sémantique, ontologies et graphiques de connaissances (p. ex. RDF/SPARQL, vocabulaires biomédicaux/chimiques).

• Mise en œuvre des données FAIR, gestion des métadonnées et outils de lignage

• Valorisation des cas d'utilisation de l'IA/ML et de l'analyse sur les données scientifiques

• Exposition de domaine en chimie, biologie, nourriture ou omique

• Les outils de rapport (p. ex. DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) constituent un avantage

• Exploiter l'IA Agentic pour automatiser les activités d'ingénierie des données

• Compétences non techniques requises

• Résolution de problèmes et état d'esprit pratique

• Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des parties prenantes

• Expérience de la collaboration avec les fournisseurs externes et les professionnels de l'information et de la conduite de la livraison par d'autres

• Capacité de travailler en équipes interfonctionnelles et internationales

• Compétences solides en matière d'organisation et de hiérarchisation

• Anglais parlé et écrit couramment

À Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sécuritaire pour tous.

jobs.title: Accounting Specialist - Nestlé Waters
jobs.description:
Location: Henniez, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Target Start Date: November 2026 or upon agreement

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As an Accounting Specialist at Nestlé Waters, your mission is to manage and analyse financial information, ensure accurate accounting and reporting, and support effective business decision-making. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with Finance and Control colleagues, internal business teams and external stakeholders. This is your opportunity to deliver meaningful results that unlock the future of beverages and experiences that elevate everyday living.

How you’ll make an impact as an Accounting Specialist

• Delivering accurate and timely accounting, financial analysis and reporting across your areas of responsibility.

• Driving monthly closing activities, journal entries and balance sheet reviews to maintain reliable financial records.

• Preparing transparent forecasts of the overheads and analysing performance against budgets to support informed business decisions.

• Ensuring strong governance, internal controls and compliance through audit support and accurate statutory declarations.

• Managing treasury information, current accounts, asset records and master data to strengthen financial visibility and control.

• Coaching and supporting the Finance apprentice while collaborating closely with Finance colleagues and cost owners to translate financial data into meaningful business insights.

What will make you successful

• Bringing very good knowledge of accounting and controlling principles, Swiss accounting standards and month-end closing processes.

• Applying good knowledge of controlling principles, financial analysis, budgeting and forecasting.

• Using SAP and Microsoft Office tools to support accounting, reporting and financial performance management activities.

• Collaborating proactively with internal stakeholders while demonstrating autonomy, accuracy and strong attention to detail.

• Communicating fluently in French and English; German is an advantage.

• Bringing to life our values of care, grit, connection and ingenuity, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé Waters, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Senior Specialist Metabolic Health – Hormone Regulation at Nestlé Research, your mission is to advance nutrition-based health solutions by deepening scientific understanding of how hormonal regulation influences metabolic health, body composition and physiological functions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, innovation partners and technical teams across Nestlé Research and the wider research and development community. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Specialist Metabolic Health – Hormone Regulation

• Leading research that links nutrition, hormonal regulation and metabolic health to create new health-focused innovation opportunities.

• Translating scientific evidence on gut hormones, insulin sensitivity, sex hormones and body composition into actionable nutrition concepts.

• Developing mechanistic insights that help move scientific observations into clear modes of action and stronger health recommendations.

• Building external scientific networks in metabolic health, endocrinology and women’s health to strengthen collaboration and future innovation.

• Contributing high-quality scientific outputs, including research milestones, publications, presentations and innovation inputs.

• Inspiring cross-functional teams and supporting junior team members through coaching and mentoring, while connecting deep scientific expertise with practical nutrition solutions that improve health outcomes.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD or MD/PhD with recognized scientific expertise in metabolic health and hormone regulation, including gut-derived hormones, insulin sensitivity and sex hormones, with extensive years of relevant experience.

• Applying experience in nutritional interventions, health outcomes and human physiology to generate robust scientific insights.

• Using project leadership, stakeholder engagement and scientific communication skills to turn evidence into meaningful innovation.

• Collaborating with curiosity, agility and creativity across research, technology and innovation teams.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Performance based bonus

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Senior Specialist Metabolic Health – Hormone Regulation at Nestlé Research, your mission is to advance nutrition-based health solutions by deepening scientific understanding of how hormonal regulation influences metabolic health, body composition and physiological functions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, innovation partners and technical teams across Nestlé Research and the wider research and development community. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Specialist Metabolic Health – Hormone Regulation

• Leading research that links nutrition, hormonal regulation and metabolic health to create new health-focused innovation opportunities.

• Translating scientific evidence on gut hormones, insulin sensitivity, sex hormones and body composition into actionable nutrition concepts.

• Developing mechanistic insights that help move scientific observations into clear modes of action and stronger health recommendations.

• Building external scientific networks in metabolic health, endocrinology and women’s health to strengthen collaboration and future innovation.

• Contributing high-quality scientific outputs, including research milestones, publications, presentations and innovation inputs.

• Inspiring cross-functional teams and supporting junior team members through coaching and mentoring, while connecting deep scientific expertise with practical nutrition solutions that improve health outcomes.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD or MD/PhD with recognized scientific expertise in metabolic health and hormone regulation, including gut-derived hormones, insulin sensitivity and sex hormones, with extensive years of relevant experience.

• Applying experience in nutritional interventions, health outcomes and human physiology to generate robust scientific insights.

• Using project leadership, stakeholder engagement and scientific communication skills to turn evidence into meaningful innovation.

jobs.description:
Strategic Research Operations

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Scientific Data Product Manager at Nestlé Research in our Computational Sciences department, your mission will be to own the lifecycle of scientific data products across agriculture, packaging, clinical research, food safety, and health & nutrition scientific domains - reinforcing and increasing value of Nestlé Research's data foundations. You will identify high-value opportunities, translate scientific needs into impactful data products, and lead cross-functional delivery from discovery through adoption and communicate the same through an engaging product roadmap.

How you’ll make an impact as a Scientific Data Product Manager

• Lead cross-functional workstreams in a dynamic research environment, defining product vision, requirements, priorities, and success criteria that align science, data, and technology.

• Partner with scientific stakeholders to identify high-value needs, improve data quality, strengthen metadata, and make research data more discoverable and reusable through FAIR principles.

• Translate scientific needs into scalable data products across bioinformatics, clinical, and omics pipelines, from discovery through adoption.

• Orchestrate internal experts — including scientists, data domain owners, architects, data scientists, engineers, and software developers — together with external partners to accelerate priority delivery.

• Champion AI-enabled data products, using automation and AI to turn trusted, well-governed scientific data into faster, smarter insights.

• Own scientific data products for the long term, balancing feasibility and impact while using adoption, satisfaction, and delivered value to guide continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bachelors or Master’s or PhD in Bioinformatics, Life sciences, Chemistry or Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent, combining scientific domain understanding with data expertise.

• Significant professional experience driving the seeding, implementation, adoption and lifecycle management of data products in a scientific context, preferably in food, life sciences or pharma.

• Required expertise:

•

• Solid experience with Bioinformatics or Clinical or Omics research data domains

• Proven ability to identify business and scientific needs, perform stakeholder analysis, translate requirements into product backlogs, and prioritize delivery based on value, feasibility and strategic alignment.

• Strong product ownership skills, including roadmap management, backlog prioritization, user-centric design, value definition, testing strategies, adoption tracking and continuous improvement.

• Solid understanding of data engineering concepts, including data models, pipelines, ETL/ELT, APIs, metadata, data quality, data governance and analytics architectures, with the ability to guide technical decisions and challenge proposals.

• Understanding of modern data ecosystems - cloud platforms, data warehouse, (e.g., Snowflake), Linux and container technologies, orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), DevOps practices.

• Nice-to-have expertise

• Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).

• FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling

• Experience with reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage

• Leadership experience

• Experience coordinating delivery through multidisciplinary internal teams and external partners.

• Ability to navigate complexity, manage ambiguity and align scientific, business and technical stakeholders around clear priorities.

• Experience in mentoring or guiding junior resources

• Excellent problem-solving, strong communication, stakeholder management and knowledge-sharing skills

• Fluent spoken and written English

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

descriptionByLocale.it:
Operazioni strategiche di ricerca

Ubicazione: Losanna, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno 100%
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Responsabile del Prodotto Scientifico presso Nestlé Research nel nostro dipartimento di Scienze Computazionali, la vostra missione sarà quella di possedere il ciclo di vita dei prodotti di dati scientifici in agricoltura, imballaggio, ricerca clinica, sicurezza alimentare e settori scientifici per la salute e la nutrizione - rinforzando e aumentando il valore delle basi dati di Nestlé Research. Identificherete le opportunità di alto valore, tradurre le esigenze scientifiche in prodotti di dati impattanti, e portare la consegna interfunzionale dalla scoperta attraverso l'adozione e comunicare lo stesso attraverso un coinvolgente roadmap del prodotto.

Come farete un impatto come responsabile del prodotto dei dati scientifici

• Condurre flussi di lavoro interfunzionali in un ambiente di ricerca dinamico, definendo la visione del prodotto, i requisiti, le priorità e i criteri di successo che allineano la scienza, i dati e la tecnologia.

• Partner con gli stakeholder scientifici per identificare esigenze di alto valore, migliorare la qualità dei dati, rafforzare i metadati e rendere i dati di ricerca più rilevabili e riutilizzabili attraverso i principi FAIR.

• Traduci le esigenze scientifiche in prodotti di dati scalabili attraverso bioinformatica, condotte cliniche e omiche, dalla scoperta attraverso l'adozione.

• Esperti interni orchestrati — tra cui scienziati, proprietari di domini dati, architetti, scienziati di dati, ingegneri e sviluppatori di software — insieme a partner esterni per accelerare la consegna prioritaria.

• Campione AI-enabled prodotti di dati, utilizzando l'automazione e AI per trasformare i dati scientifici affidabili e ben governati in insight più veloci e intelligenti.

• I propri prodotti di dati scientifici a lungo termine, bilanciando la fattibilità e l'impatto utilizzando l'adozione, la soddisfazione e il valore fornito per guidare il miglioramento continuo.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Bachelor o Master o PhD in Bioinformatica, scienze della vita, chimica o informatica, ingegneria o equivalente, combinando la comprensione del dominio scientifico con l'esperienza dei dati.

• Esperienza professionale significativa che guida la semina, l'implementazione, l'adozione e la gestione del ciclo di vita dei prodotti di dati in un contesto scientifico, preferibilmente in cibo, scienze della vita o farmaci.

• Competenza necessaria:

•

• Esperienza solida con domini di dati di ricerca Bioinformatics o Clinical o Omics

• Capacità comprovata di identificare le esigenze aziendali e scientifiche, eseguire l'analisi delle parti interessate, tradurre i requisiti in backlog di prodotto, e prioritizzare la consegna in base a valore, fattibilità e allineamento strategico.

• Forte capacità di proprietà del prodotto, tra cui gestione roadmap, priorità backlog, design user-centric, definizione del valore, strategie di test, monitoraggio dell'adozione e miglioramento continuo.

• Solida comprensione dei concetti di ingegneria dei dati, tra cui modelli di dati, pipeline, ETL/ELT, API, metadati, qualità dei dati, governance dei dati e architetture di analisi, con la capacità di guidare decisioni tecniche e proposte di sfida.

• Comprensione degli ecosistemi di dati moderni - piattaforme cloud, data warehouse, (ad esempio, Snowflake), tecnologie Linux e container, strumenti di orchestrazione (ad esempio, Airflow), pratiche DevOps.

• Competenza piacevole da avere

• Modellazione semantica, onlogie e grafi di conoscenza (ad esempio, RDF/SPARQL, vocabulari biomedici/chimici).

• implementazione dei dati FAIR, gestione dei metadati e strumenti di linea

• L'esperienza con strumenti di reporting (ad esempio, DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) è un vantaggio

• Esperienza di leadership

• Esperienza coordinando la consegna attraverso team interni multidisciplinari e partner esterni.

• Capacità di navigare nella complessità, gestire l'ambiguità e allineare gli stakeholder scientifici, aziendali e tecnici intorno a priorità chiare.

• Esperienza nella mentoring o guida delle risorse junior

• Eccellente problem solving, comunicazione forte, gestione delle parti interessate e competenze di condivisione delle conoscenze

• Fluente parlato e scritto inglese

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Strategische Forschung

Standort: Lausanne, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid / Vollzeit 100%
Vertragsart/Dauer: Permanent

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Scientific Data Product Manager bei Nestlé Research in unserer Computational Sciences-Abteilung besteht Ihre Mission darin, den Lebenszyklus wissenschaftlicher Datenprodukte in den Bereichen Landwirtschaft, Verpackung, klinische Forschung, Lebensmittelsicherheit sowie Gesundheit und Ernährung zu besitzen - was den Wert der Datengrundlagen von Nestlé Research stärkt und erhöht. Sie identifizieren hochwertige Möglichkeiten, übersetzen wissenschaftliche Bedürfnisse in wirkungsvolle Datenprodukte und führen die funktionsübergreifende Bereitstellung von der Entdeckung bis zur Einführung und kommunizieren diese über eine ansprechende Produkt-Roadmap.

Wie Sie als Scientific Data Product Manager etwas bewirken

• Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende Workstreams in einer dynamischen Forschungsumgebung und definieren Sie Produktvision, Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Erfolgskriterien, die Wissenschaft, Daten und Technologie in Einklang bringen.

• Zusammenarbeit mit wissenschaftlichen Interessengruppen, um hochwertige Bedürfnisse zu identifizieren, die Datenqualität zu verbessern, Metadaten zu stärken und Forschungsdaten durch FAIR-Prinzipien besser auffindbar und wiederverwendbar zu machen.

• Übersetzen wissenschaftlicher Bedürfnisse in skalierbare Datenprodukte über Bioinformatik-, klinische und Omics-Pipelines hinweg, von der Entdeckung bis zur Einführung.

• Orchestrieren Sie interne Experten - darunter Wissenschaftler, Datendomänenbesitzer, Architekten, Datenwissenschaftler, Ingenieure und Softwareentwickler - zusammen mit externen Partnern, um die Bereitstellung von Prioritäten zu beschleunigen.

• Champion AI-fähige Datenprodukte, die Automatisierung und KI nutzen, um vertrauenswürdige, gut verwaltete wissenschaftliche Daten in schnellere, intelligentere Erkenntnisse umzuwandeln.

• Eigene wissenschaftliche Datenprodukte langfristig, die Machbarkeit und Wirkung ausbalancieren und gleichzeitig Akzeptanz, Zufriedenheit und gelieferten Wert nutzen, um kontinuierliche Verbesserungen zu ermöglichen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bachelor oder Master oder PhD in Bioinformatik, Biowissenschaften, Chemie oder Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder gleichwertig, die wissenschaftliche Domänenverständnis mit Daten-Know-how kombinieren.

• Bedeutende Berufserfahrung bei der Aussaat, Implementierung, Annahme und dem Lebenszyklusmanagement von Datenprodukten in einem wissenschaftlichen Kontext, vorzugsweise in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Biowissenschaften oder Pharma.

• Erforderliches Fachwissen:

•

• Solide Erfahrung mit Bioinformatik oder klinischen oder Omics Forschungsdatendomänen

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, geschäftliche und wissenschaftliche Bedürfnisse zu identifizieren, Stakeholder-Analysen durchzuführen, Anforderungen in Produkt-Backlogs zu übersetzen und die Lieferung basierend auf Wert, Machbarkeit und strategischer Ausrichtung zu priorisieren.

• Starke Product-Ownership-Fähigkeiten, einschließlich Roadmap-Management, Backlog-Priorisierung, benutzerzentriertes Design, Wertdefinition, Teststrategien, Adoptionsverfolgung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

• Solides Verständnis von Data-Engineering-Konzepten, einschließlich Datenmodellen, Pipelines, ETL/ELT, APIs, Metadaten, Datenqualität, Data Governance und Analysearchitekturen, mit der Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen zu treffen und Vorschläge herauszufordern.

• Verständnis moderner Datenökosysteme - Cloud-Plattformen, Data Warehouse (z. B. Snowflake), Linux- und Containertechnologien, Orchestrierungstools (z. B. Airflow), DevOps-Praktiken.

• Nice-to-have Expertise

• Semantische Modellierung, Ontologien und Wissensgraphen (z. B. RDF / SPARQL, biomedizinische / chemische Vokabulare).

• FAIR Datenimplementierung, Metadatenmanagement und Lineage Tooling

• Erfahrung mit Reporting Tools (z.B. DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) ist von Vorteil

• Führungserfahrung

• Erfahrung in der Koordination der Lieferung durch multidisziplinäre interne Teams und externe Partner.

• Fähigkeit, Komplexität zu steuern, Mehrdeutigkeiten zu verwalten und wissenschaftliche, geschäftliche und technische Interessengruppen auf klare Prioritäten auszurichten.

• Erfahrung in Mentoring oder Führung Junior Ressourcen

• Ausgezeichnete Problemlösung, starke Kommunikation, Stakeholder-Management und Wissensaustausch

• fließend gesprochenes und geschriebenes Englisch

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun.

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Videointerview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird die Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Opérations stratégiques de recherche

Lieu: Lausanne, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Hybride / Temps plein 100%
Type de contrat / durée: Permanent

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

En tant que responsable de produit de données scientifiques chez Nestlé Research dans notre département des Sciences Computationnelles, votre mission sera de posséder le cycle de vie des produits de données scientifiques dans les domaines scientifiques de l'agriculture, de l'emballage, de la recherche clinique, de la sécurité alimentaire, de la santé et de la nutrition - renforçant et augmentant la valeur des bases de données de Nestlé Research. Vous identifierez des possibilités de grande valeur, traduireez les besoins scientifiques en produits de données pertinents et dirigerez la prestation interfonctionnelle de la découverte à l'adoption et communiquerez la même chose au moyen d'une feuille de route de produits engageants.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que gestionnaire de produits de données scientifiques

• Diriger les secteurs de travail transfonctionnels dans un environnement de recherche dynamique, en définissant la vision des produits, les exigences, les priorités et les critères de réussite qui harmonisent la science, les données et la technologie.

• Établir des partenariats avec les intervenants scientifiques afin d'identifier les besoins de grande valeur, d'améliorer la qualité des données, de renforcer les métadonnées et de rendre les données de recherche plus accessibles et réutilisables grâce aux principes FAIR.

• Traduire les besoins scientifiques en produits de données évolutives sur les pipelines bioinformatique, clinique et omique, de la découverte à l'adoption.

• Ordonner des experts internes, y compris des scientifiques, des propriétaires de domaines de données, des architectes, des spécialistes de données, des ingénieurs et des développeurs de logiciels, en collaboration avec des partenaires externes, afin d'accélérer l'exécution des priorités.

• Les produits de données compatibles avec l'IA Champion, utilisant l'automatisation et l'IA pour transformer des données scientifiques fiables et bien gérées en informations plus rapides et plus intelligentes.

• Produits de données scientifiques propres à long terme, équilibrer la faisabilité et l'impact tout en utilisant l'adoption, la satisfaction et la valeur fournie pour guider l'amélioration continue.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise ou doctorat en bioinformatique, sciences de la vie, chimie ou informatique, génie ou équivalent, combinant la compréhension du domaine scientifique avec l'expertise en données.

• Expérience professionnelle importante à l'origine de l'ensemencement, de la mise en oeuvre, de l'adoption et de la gestion du cycle de vie des produits de données dans un contexte scientifique, de préférence dans les domaines des aliments, des sciences de la vie ou des produits pharmaceutiques.

• Expertise requise:

•

• Expérience solide dans les domaines de la bioinformatique ou de la recherche clinique ou omique

• Capacité éprouvée d'identifier les besoins commerciaux et scientifiques, d'effectuer une analyse des intervenants, de traduire les besoins en arriérés de produits et de prioriser la prestation en fonction de la valeur, de la faisabilité et de l'alignement stratégique.

• Fortes compétences en matière de propriété des produits, y compris la gestion de la feuille de route, la hiérarchisation des arriérés, la conception axée sur l'utilisateur, la définition de la valeur, les stratégies d'essai, le suivi des adoptions et l'amélioration continue.

• Une bonne compréhension des concepts d'ingénierie des données, y compris les modèles de données, les pipelines, ETL/ELT, les API, les métadonnées, la qualité des données, la gouvernance des données et les architectures analytiques, avec la capacité de guider les décisions techniques et les propositions de contestation.

• Compréhension des écosystèmes de données modernes - plateformes cloud, entrepôt de données, (p. ex., Snowflake), technologies Linux et conteneurs, outils d'orchestration (p. ex., Airflow), pratiques DevOps.

• Bonne expérience

• Modélisation sémantique, ontologies et graphiques de connaissances (p. ex., RDF/SPARQL, vocabulaire biomédical/chimique).

• Mise en oeuvre des données FAIR, gestion des métadonnées et outils de lignage

• L'expérience des outils de rapport (p. ex. DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) est un avantage

• Expérience en matière de leadership

• Expérience de la coordination de l'exécution par des équipes internes multidisciplinaires et des partenaires externes.

• Capacité de naviguer dans la complexité, de gérer l'ambiguïté et d'aligner les intervenants scientifiques, commerciaux et techniques sur des priorités claires.

• Expérience en mentorat ou en orientation des ressources juniors

• Excellente capacité de résolution de problèmes, communication solide, gestion des parties prenantes et partage des connaissances

• Anglais parlé et écrit

À Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime basée sur les performances

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte contribution de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue vidéo avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé ne communiquera qu'avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.
