jobs.title: Senior Acquisitions & Business Development Manager

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire principal des acquisitions et du développement des affaires

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey - Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Senior Acquisitions & Business Development Manager within our global M&A team, you will play a key role in shaping and executing strategic corporate projects that support the long-term growth of the Nestlé Group. Leading acquisitions, divestments, joint-ventures and other high-impact initiatives, you will ensure strong governance, rigorous valuation, and effective negotiations that create value and manage risk. Working closely with Zone and SBU leadership, Market Heads and CFOs, senior management, and specialist internal and external partners, you will help turn strategic opportunities into measurable business impact on a global scale, working across categories and geographies.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Acquisition & Business Development Manager

• Partner with Zones and Strategic Business Units to shape M&A strategies and evaluate potential acquisition or divestment opportunities.

• Lead end-to-end acquisition and divestment processes, ensuring projects follow the appropriate governance and approval requirements.

• Assess financial, strategic, and operational risks and opportunities to strengthen decision-making and negotiation positions.

• Lead negotiations on transaction agreements to optimize value and manage risk for Nestlé.

• Provide timely, clear, and decision-relevant information to senior management throughout the project lifecycle.

• Coordinate internal specialists and manage relationships with investment banks, financial advisers, accounting advisers, legal counsel, and other external partners to ensure the timely completion of projects.

What will make you successful

• Extensive experience in mergers and acquisitions or in leading complex projects within a multinational organization, consultancy, investment bank, or financial advisory environment.

• Strong expertise in financial management, business analysis, valuation, governance, risk management, and strategic business planning.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions, businesses, and geographies.

• Fluency in English, with additional languages considered an advantage, combined with flexibility, sound judgement, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex global environment.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, interviews with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role on the date listed above, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

jobs.title: Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa)
jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As an Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa) at Nestlé Research, your mission is to contribute to the design and delivery of coffee and cocoa regenerative agriculture research aligned with corporate Creating Shared Value commitments and the business-endorsed Nestlé Institute of Agricultural Sciences research strategy. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with agricultural systems teams, project leaders, researchers, agronomists, operations teams, farmers, research institutes, universities and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa)

• Implementing regenerative agriculture research that advance the creation of shared value in coffee and cocoa production systems.

• Coordinate state-of-the-art field trials, data collection, and analysis with internal teams and external partners.

• Use scientific rigour to turn high-quality data collection into robust research outputs.

• Convert research findings into practical guidance and recommendations for on-farm deployment.

• Deliver novel research insights within agreed timelines, milestones, standards, and budgets.

• Build regenerative agriculture expertise to strengthen team performance and scientific collaboration.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD in agronomy, agriculture, plant science or a related discipline along with practical experience in agricultural research, field trials or applied agronomy, ideally with exposure to coffee or cocoa.

• Applying regenerative agriculture, crop management and soil health knowledge to deliver robust research outcomes.

• Using data analysis, documentation and reporting tools to create clear, traceable and actionable technical outputs.

• Collaborating across scientific, technical and operational audiences with practical problem solving, attention to detail and timely communication.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead at Nestlé Research, your mission is to ensure Nestlé Research has access to the best science globally. By leading research alliances, science insourcing, and scientific intelligence, you will strengthen access to external expertise, scientific knowledge, literature, and innovation ecosystems that complement and amplify Nestlé Research’s scientific capabilities. Working closely with research leaders, science and technology teams, legal and contract partners, universities, research institutes, startups, scientific publishers, associations, and external experts, you will help transform ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead

• Leading the research alliances and science insourcing strategy to build high-value partnerships with academia, startups, publishers, scientific and innovation ecosystems.

• Driving strategic collaborations that accelerate discovery, strengthen innovation impact, and support Nestlé Research priorities.

• Creating seamless access to internal and external scientific knowledge by connecting researchers to experts, scientific literature, publishers, information sources, and research services that expand Nestlé Research capabilities.

• Transforming scientific intelligence into a strategic capability by identifying, connecting, and translating emerging scientific trends, publications, and external expertise into actionable insights for research and innovation.

• Strengthening Nestlé Research’s scientific reputation by building trusted relationships with universities, talent pools, and external thought leaders.

• Developing an engaged, inclusive, and future-ready team that builds capabilities, fosters collaboration, and delivers shared priorities.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD or equivalent scientific background, combined with the credibility and curiosity to connect cutting-edge science with business needs, innovation opportunities, and long-term value creation.

• Applying 10+ years of experience in R&D, scientific innovation, external collaborations, or related scientific leadership to shape strategy, influence stakeholders, and deliver measurable impact.

• Leveraging strong experience across Nestlé Research, Nestlé Product Technology Centers, and the broader R&D organization to foster connections between capabilities, partnerships, expertise, and scientific services, ensuring alignment with business and innovation priorities.

• Demonstrating success in academic partnerships, innovation ecosystems, with a proven ability to create trusted relationships and deliver measurable impact.

• Proven experience in leading complex initiatives in a direct or indirect leadership role.

• Bringing experience in the management, development, or strategic utilization of scientific infrastructures, research services, knowledge platforms, or shared capabilities.

• Demonstrating strong strategic communication and influencing skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific topics into compelling narratives, build alignment, and engage diverse internal and external stakeholders.

• Bringing collaboration, intellectual curiosity, fresh thinking, constructive challenge, respect, and a positive mindset.

Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente
Data di inizio destinazione: appena possibile

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead at Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è garantire che Nestlé Research abbia accesso alla migliore scienza a livello globale. Con le principali alleanze di ricerca, insourcing scientifico e intelligenza scientifica, rafforzerete l’accesso a competenze esterne, conoscenze scientifiche, letteratura e ecosistemi di innovazione che completano e amplificano le capacità scientifiche di Nestlé Research. Lavorando a stretto contatto con leader di ricerca, team di scienza e tecnologia, partner legali e contrattuali, università, istituti di ricerca, startup, editori scientifici, associazioni ed esperti esterni, vi aiuterà a trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come Ricerca alleanze & Scienza Insourcing Lead

• Guidare le alleanze di ricerca e la strategia di insourcing della scienza per costruire partnership di alto valore con accademia, startup, editori, ecosistemi scientifici e innovativi.

• Guidare collaborazioni strategiche che accelerano la scoperta, rafforzare l'impatto dell'innovazione e sostenere le priorità di Nestlé Research.

• Creare un accesso senza soluzione di continuità alle conoscenze scientifiche interne ed esterne collegando ricercatori a esperti, letteratura scientifica, editori, fonti di informazione e servizi di ricerca che espandono le capacità di Nestlé Research.

• Trasformare l'intelligenza scientifica in una capacità strategica identificando, collegando e traducendo tendenze scientifiche emergenti, pubblicazioni e competenze esterne in insight attuabili per la ricerca e l'innovazione.

• Rafforzare la reputazione scientifica di Nestlé Research costruendo relazioni di fiducia con università, pool di talenti e leader di pensiero esterni.

• Sviluppare un team impegnato, inclusivo e pronto per il futuro che costruisce capacità, promuove la collaborazione e offre priorità condivise.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare un dottorato o un background scientifico equivalente, combinato con la credibilità e la curiosità di collegare la scienza all'avanguardia con le esigenze aziendali, le opportunità di innovazione e la creazione di valore a lungo termine.

• Applicando 10+ anni di esperienza in R&D, innovazione scientifica, collaborazioni esterne, o relativa leadership scientifica per modellare la strategia, influenzare le parti interessate e fornire un impatto misurabile.

• Sfruttando una forte esperienza tra Nestlé Research, Nestlé Product Technology Centers e la più ampia organizzazione R&D per promuovere connessioni tra capacità, partnership, competenze e servizi scientifici, garantendo l'allineamento con le priorità di business e innovazione.

• Dimostrando il successo in partnership accademiche, ecosistemi di innovazione, con una comprovata capacità di creare relazioni affidabili e fornire un impatto misurabile.

• Esperienza dimostrata nelle principali iniziative complesse in un ruolo di leadership diretto o indiretto.

• Portare esperienza nella gestione, sviluppo, o utilizzo strategico di infrastrutture scientifiche, servizi di ricerca, piattaforme di conoscenza, o capacità condivise.

• Dimostrare una forte comunicazione strategica e influenzare le competenze, con la capacità di tradurre argomenti scientifici complessi in narrazioni convincenti, costruire allineamento, e coinvolgere diversi stakeholder interni ed esterni.

• Portare la collaborazione, la curiosità intellettuale, il pensiero fresco, la sfida costruttiva, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead bei Nestlé Research möchten Sie sicherstellen, dass Nestlé Research Zugang zu den besten Wissenschaften weltweit hat. Durch die Leitung von Forschungsallianzen, Science Insourcing und Scientific Intelligence stärken Sie den Zugang zu externem Fachwissen, wissenschaftlichem Wissen, Literatur und Innovationsökosystemen, die die wissenschaftlichen Fähigkeiten von Nestlé Research ergänzen und erweitern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Forschungsleitern, Wissenschafts- und Technologieteams, Rechts- und Vertragspartnern, Universitäten, Forschungsinstituten, Start-ups, wissenschaftlichen Verlagen, Verbänden und externen Experten helfen Sie dabei, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead Einfluss nehmen können

• Führen der Forschungsallianzen und der Science-Insourcing-Strategie zum Aufbau hochwertiger Partnerschaften mit Hochschulen, Startups, Verlagen, wissenschaftlichen und Innovationsökosystemen.

• Förderung strategischer Kooperationen, die die Entdeckung beschleunigen, die Innovationswirkung stärken und die Prioritäten von Nestlé Research unterstützen.

• Schaffung eines nahtlosen Zugangs zu internen und externen wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnissen durch die Verbindung von Forschern mit Experten, wissenschaftlicher Literatur, Verlagen, Informationsquellen und Forschungsdiensten, die Nestlé Research Fähigkeiten erweitern.

• Die Transformation wissenschaftlicher Intelligenz in eine strategische Fähigkeit durch die Identifizierung, Verknüpfung und Übersetzung von aufkommenden wissenschaftlichen Trends, Publikationen und externem Fachwissen in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse für Forschung und Innovation.

• Stärkung des wissenschaftlichen Rufs von Nestlé Research durch den Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger Beziehungen zu Universitäten, Talentpools und externen Vordenkern.

• Entwicklung eines engagierten, integrativen und zukunftsfähigen Teams, das Fähigkeiten aufbaut, die Zusammenarbeit fördert und gemeinsame Prioritäten setzt.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bringen Sie einen PhD oder einen gleichwertigen wissenschaftlichen Hintergrund mit, kombiniert mit der Glaubwürdigkeit und Neugier, Spitzenwissenschaft mit Geschäftsanforderungen, Innovationsmöglichkeiten und langfristiger Wertschöpfung zu verbinden.

• Anwendung von mehr als 10 Jahren Erfahrung in Forschung und Entwicklung, wissenschaftlicher Innovation, externer Zusammenarbeit oder verwandter wissenschaftlicher Führung, um Strategien zu gestalten, Interessengruppen zu beeinflussen und messbare Auswirkungen zu erzielen.

• Nutzung starker Erfahrung in Nestlé Research, Nestlé Product Technology Centern und der breiteren F & E-Organisation, um Verbindungen zwischen Fähigkeiten, Partnerschaften, Fachwissen und wissenschaftlichen Dienstleistungen zu fördern und die Ausrichtung auf Geschäfts- und Innovationsprioritäten sicherzustellen.

• Nachweis des Erfolgs in akademischen Partnerschaften, Innovationsökosystemen, mit der nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen aufzubauen und messbare Auswirkungen zu erzielen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Initiativen in einer direkten oder indirekten Führungsrolle.

• Mitbringen von Erfahrung in der Verwaltung, Entwicklung oder strategischen Nutzung von wissenschaftlichen Infrastrukturen, Forschungsdienstleistungen, Wissensplattformen oder gemeinsamen Fähigkeiten.

• Demonstrieren starker strategischer Kommunikation und beeinflussender Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe wissenschaftliche Themen in überzeugende Narrative zu übersetzen, Ausrichtung aufzubauen und verschiedene interne und externe Interessengruppen einzubeziehen.

• Bringt Zusammenarbeit, intellektuelle Neugier, frisches Denken, konstruktive Herausforderung, Respekt und eine positive Denkweise.

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

En tant que responsable des alliances de recherche et de l'approvisionnement scientifique chez Nestlé Research, votre mission est de vous assurer que Nestlé Research a accès aux meilleures sciences du monde. En dirigeant des alliances de recherche, des ressources scientifiques et de l'intelligence scientifique, vous renforcerez l'accès à l'expertise externe, aux connaissances scientifiques, à la littérature et aux écosystèmes d'innovation qui complètent et amplifient les capacités scientifiques de Nestlé Research. Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des responsables de la recherche, des équipes scientifiques et technologiques, des partenaires juridiques et contractuels, des universités, des instituts de recherche, des startups, des éditeurs scientifiques, des associations et des experts externes, vous aiderez à transformer des idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les personnes, les animaux domestiques et la planète.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead

• Diriger les alliances de recherche et la stratégie d'approvisionnement scientifique pour établir des partenariats de grande valeur avec les universités, les startups, les éditeurs, les écosystèmes scientifiques et d'innovation.

• Diriger des collaborations stratégiques qui accélèrent la découverte, renforcent l'impact de l'innovation et soutiennent les priorités de Nestlé Research.

• Créer un accès transparent aux connaissances scientifiques internes et externes en reliant les chercheurs aux experts, à la littérature scientifique, aux éditeurs, aux sources d'information et aux services de recherche qui élargissent les capacités de recherche de Nestlé.

• Transformer l'intelligence scientifique en une capacité stratégique en identifiant, en reliant et en transformant les nouvelles tendances scientifiques, les publications et l'expertise externe en idées pratiques pour la recherche et l'innovation.

• Renforcer la réputation scientifique de Nestlé en établissant des relations de confiance avec les universités, les bassins de talents et les leaders de la pensée externe.

• Développer une équipe engagée, inclusive et prête à l'avenir qui renforce les capacités, favorise la collaboration et réalise des priorités communes.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter un doctorat ou un bagage scientifique équivalent, combiné avec la crédibilité et la curiosité de relier la science de pointe aux besoins des entreprises, aux possibilités d'innovation et à la création de valeur à long terme.

• Appliquer plus de 10 ans d'expérience en R-D, en innovation scientifique, en collaboration externe ou en leadership scientifique connexe pour façonner la stratégie, influencer les intervenants et produire des résultats mesurables.

• Tirer parti d'une solide expérience dans les centres de recherche Nestlé, les centres de technologie des produits Nestlé et l'organisation plus vaste de R-D pour favoriser les liens entre les capacités, les partenariats, l'expertise et les services scientifiques, en assurant l'harmonisation avec les priorités des entreprises et de l'innovation.

• Démontrer le succès dans les partenariats universitaires, les écosystèmes d'innovation, avec une capacité avérée de créer des relations de confiance et d'obtenir un impact mesurable.

• Expérience éprouvée dans la conduite d'initiatives complexes dans un rôle de leadership direct ou indirect.

• Apporter de l'expérience dans la gestion, le développement ou l'utilisation stratégique des infrastructures scientifiques, des services de recherche, des plateformes de connaissances ou des capacités partagées.

• Démontrer une communication stratégique solide et influencer les compétences, avec la capacité de traduire des sujets scientifiques complexes en récits convaincants, construire l'alignement, et mobiliser divers intervenants internes et externes.

• Apporter collaboration, curiosité intellectuelle, pensée fraîche, défi constructif, respect, et un état d'esprit positif.

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As an Associate Robotics Specialist at the Nestlé Deep Tech Center , your mission is to help identify, evaluate, develop and deploy advanced robotics and intelligent automation solutions that turn emerging technologies into scalable manufacturing solutions. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with project teams, research and development centers, engineering hubs, factories, pilot plants, quality labs, suppliers, system integrators, universities and technology partners. jobs.title: Research Assistant in Fermentation
jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: On-site / Full-time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Research Assistant in Fermentation at Nestlé Research, your mission is to design and deliver fermentation experiments that advance applied microbiology research and help translate scientific insights across scales. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, technicians, students, and internal stakeholders. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Research Assistant in Fermentation

• Designing and delivering laboratory experiments that advance fermentation research across diverse microorganisms and bioreactor systems.

• Translating scientific insights across fermentation scales to strengthen the path from research to practical application.

• Developing and implementing fermentation technologies that expand research capabilities and improve experimental outcomes.

• Maintaining reliable fermentation equipment and robust laboratory practices to support safe, high-quality research.

• Coaching technicians and students to build capability, encourage knowledge sharing, and strengthen team performance.

• Communicating clear, actionable results that help internal stakeholders make informed research decisions.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong applied knowledge of microbiology, biotechnology, and fermentation science.

• Applying hands-on expertise with laboratory-scale bioreactor systems and fermentation processes.

• Using knowledge of industrial-scale fermentation and downstream processing to connect research with broader applications.

• Collaborating effectively in interdisciplinary teams with a proactive, innovative, and clear communication style.

• Communicating fluently in English; French is an advantage.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Losanna, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: On-site / A tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Come Assistente di Ricerca nella Fermentazione presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di progettare e fornire esperimenti di fermentazione che avanzano la ricerca microbiologica applicata e aiutano a tradurre intuizioni scientifiche su scala. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con scienziati, tecnici, studenti e parti interessate interne. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come Assistente di Ricerca nella Fermentazione

• Progettare e fornire esperimenti di laboratorio che avanzano la ricerca di fermentazione attraverso diversi microrganismi e sistemi di bioreattore.

• Tradurre intuizioni scientifiche su scala di fermentazione per rafforzare il percorso dalla ricerca all'applicazione pratica.

• Sviluppare e implementare tecnologie di fermentazione che ampliano le capacità di ricerca e migliorano i risultati sperimentali.

• Mantenere apparecchiature di fermentazione affidabili e pratiche di laboratorio robuste per supportare la ricerca sicura e di alta qualità.

• coaching tecnici e studenti per costruire capacità, incoraggiare la condivisione delle conoscenze e rafforzare le prestazioni del team.

• Comunicare risultati chiari e fattibili che aiutano gli stakeholder interni a prendere decisioni di ricerca informate.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte conoscenza applicata della microbiologia, della biotecnologia e della scienza della fermentazione.

• Applicare competenze pratiche con sistemi di bioreattore su scala di laboratorio e processi di fermentazione.

• Utilizzando la conoscenza della fermentazione su scala industriale e della lavorazione a valle per collegare la ricerca con applicazioni più ampie.

• Collaborare efficacemente in team interdisciplinari con uno stile di comunicazione proattivo, innovativo e chiaro.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese; il francese è un vantaggio.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva e orientata al benessere.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti dei dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione include tipicamente un video intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che un forte elenco di candidati pertinenti è identificato, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Standort: Lausanne, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort / Vollzeit
Vertragsart/Dauer: Permanent

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Forschungsassistent in der Fermentation bei Nestlé Research besteht Ihre Mission darin, Fermentationsexperimente zu entwerfen und durchzuführen, die die angewandte mikrobiologische Forschung voranbringen und dazu beitragen, wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse über Skalen hinweg zu übersetzen. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Wissenschaftlern, Technikern, Studenten und internen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Forschungsassistent in der Fermentation etwas bewirken werden

• Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von Laborexperimenten, die die Fermentationsforschung in verschiedenen Mikroorganismen und Bioreaktorsystemen vorantreiben.

• Übersetzen wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse über Fermentationsskalen hinweg, um den Weg von der Forschung zur praktischen Anwendung zu stärken.

• Entwicklung und Implementierung von Fermentationstechnologien, die die Forschungskapazitäten erweitern und die experimentellen Ergebnisse verbessern.

• Pflege zuverlässiger Fermentationsgeräte und robuster Laborpraktiken zur Unterstützung einer sicheren, qualitativ hochwertigen Forschung.

• Coaching von Technikern und Studenten, um Fähigkeiten aufzubauen, den Wissensaustausch zu fördern und die Teamleistung zu stärken.

• Kommunikation klarer, umsetzbarer Ergebnisse, die internen Interessengruppen helfen, fundierte Forschungsentscheidungen zu treffen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bringen Sie starke angewandte Kenntnisse der Mikrobiologie, Biotechnologie und Fermentationswissenschaft.

• Anwendung von praktischer Expertise bei Bioreaktorsystemen und Fermentationsprozessen im Labormaßstab.

• Nutzung des Wissens über industrielle Fermentation und nachgelagerte Verarbeitung, um Forschung mit breiteren Anwendungen zu verbinden.

• Effektive Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams mit einem proaktiven, innovativen und klaren Kommunikationsstil.

• Fließend auf Englisch kommunizieren; Französisch ist ein Vorteil.

• Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun.

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Videointerview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit für #BreakthroughTogether?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

En tant qu'assistant de recherche en fermentation chez Nestlé Research, votre mission est de concevoir et de livrer des expériences de fermentation qui font avancer la recherche en microbiologie appliquée et aident à traduire les connaissances scientifiques à travers les échelles. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec les scientifiques, les techniciens, les étudiants et les intervenants internes. C'est l'occasion de transformer les idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les gens, les animaux de compagnie et la planète.

Comment vous aurez un impact en tant qu'assistant de recherche en fermentation

• Concevoir et livrer des expériences en laboratoire qui font progresser la recherche sur la fermentation dans divers microorganismes et systèmes bioréacteurs.

• Traduire les connaissances scientifiques à travers les échelles de fermentation pour renforcer le chemin de la recherche à l'application pratique.

• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des technologies de fermentation qui élargissent les capacités de recherche et améliorent les résultats expérimentaux.

• Maintenir un équipement de fermentation fiable et des pratiques de laboratoire robustes pour soutenir la recherche sûre et de haute qualité.

• Encadrer les techniciens et les étudiants pour renforcer les capacités, encourager le partage des connaissances et renforcer la performance de l'équipe.

• Communiquer des résultats clairs et concrets qui aident les intervenants internes à prendre des décisions éclairées en matière de recherche.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide connaissance appliquée de la microbiologie, de la biotechnologie et des sciences de la fermentation.

• Appliquer l'expertise pratique avec les systèmes bioréacteurs à l'échelle du laboratoire et les procédés de fermentation.

• Utiliser la connaissance de la fermentation industrielle et du traitement en aval pour relier la recherche à des applications plus larges.

• Collaborer efficacement dans des équipes interdisciplinaires avec un style de communication proactif, innovateur et clair.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais; le français est un avantage.

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée nouvelle, les questions audacieuses, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être.

À Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime fondée sur les performances

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte contribution de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Un congé parental généreux et des solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue vidéo avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de façon confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses électroniques officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à n'importe quelle étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à #BreakthroughTogether ?

Appliquer maintenant et façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

jobs.description:
The Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee (NPTC Coffee) is the leading R&D organization that discovers, develops and deploys coffee and beverage products and technologies for in-home and out-of-home consumption. It consists of units in Konolfingen (CH), Marysville (USA), Orbe (CH) and Singapore and provides new products and processes to all Nestlé markets worldwide.

Our mission – to delight the consumer wherever, whenever, however by delivering moments of genuine pleasure and indulgence - drives the need for us to attract, select and develop the right people for the right jobs throughout the value chain of our business.

Position Snapshot

Location: Orbe, Switzerland

Company: Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee
Act. Rate: Full-Time Act. Rate 100%
Type of contract: Permanent contract

Start date: As soon as possible

Deadline for applications: 28 / 02 /2026

Position Summary

As a Coffee Automation Digital Engineer , you will lead and drive digital technology exploration and technology transfer to industrialization within the coffee category, ensuring the integration of innovative solutions that enhance operational efficiency and product development. This is an amazing opportunity to drive innovation and have a direct impact on advancing the digital and automation agenda for the manufacturing technologies of Nestlé at global scale.

A Day in the Life of a Coffee Automation Digital Engineer

• Serve as the technical expert on state of the art digital and automation tools and technologies used in coffee and build organisational capability through the train the trainer approach.

• Lead the exploration and development of digital capabilities in collaboration with IT, Zones, and technology partners to continuously evolve the Digital & Automation roadmap for coffee.

• Oversee the deployment and adoption of the Digital & Automation roadmap across Zones and operations, ensuring effective technology transfer and sustainable implementation.

• Drive and technically evaluate proofs of concept, assessing improvements and supporting the successful scale up of validated technologies.

• Establish and maintain digital and automation technology standards, ensuring alignment across Zones and promoting best practice sharing throughout the coffee manufacturing network.

What will make you successful

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Software, Telecommunications engineering, Automation or equivalent

• Extensive experience in R&D, Data Analytics, Automation, Industrial IT, or software engineering

• Advanced technical knowledge in Data Analytics, Software Development, or Automation

• Proven track record of successful project execution and technology implementation, with strong project and change management capabilities

• Experience leading cross-functional teams effectively with excellent communication & interpersonal skills.

• Proficient in user-centered design and agile methodologies, with the ability to adapt to evolving project requirements is a strong plus

• Strong curiosity and passion for innovation with a hands-on attitude

• Courage to challenge the status quo with a strong collaborative mindset

• Languages : Fluency in English, and other language considered a plus

Nestlé is committed to the accessibility of its recruitment process. If you require an adaptation during the recruitment process, please do let us know so we can support you effectively. All information will be treated confidentially.

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference. We do this by fostering a diverse, friendly, supportive, and collaborative environment, that creates positive disruption, embraces innovation, and empowers people and teams to win. We aim to hire friendly, respectful, inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.

Be a force for good. Join Nestlé and visit us on www.nestle.com .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee (NPTC Coffee) è la principale organizzazione R&D che scopre, sviluppa e distribuisce prodotti di caffè e bevande e tecnologie per il consumo in-home e out-of-home. Si compone di unità a Konolfingen (CH), Marysville (USA), Orbe (CH) e Singapore e fornisce nuovi prodotti e processi a tutti i mercati Nestlé in tutto il mondo.

La nostra missione – per deliziare il consumatore ovunque, ogni volta che, tuttavia, offrendo momenti di autentico piacere e indulgenza - spinge la necessità per noi di attrarre, selezionare e sviluppare le persone giuste per i posti di lavoro giusti in tutta la catena di valore del nostro business.

Primo piano

Ubicazione: Orbe, Svizzera

Azienda: Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee
Atto. Tariffa: Atto a tempo pieno. Tasso 100%
Tipo di contratto: Contratto permanente

Data di inizio: appena possibile

Termine ultimo per le applicazioni: 28 / 02 /2026

Posizione Sommario

In qualità di Coffee Automation Digital Engineer , guiderai e guiderai l'esplorazione della tecnologia digitale e il trasferimento tecnologico all'industrializzazione all'interno della categoria caffè, garantendo l'integrazione di soluzioni innovative che migliorano l'efficienza operativa e lo sviluppo del prodotto. Questa è una straordinaria opportunità per guidare l'innovazione e avere un impatto diretto sul progresso dell'agenda digitale e dell'automazione per le tecnologie di produzione di Nestlé a livello globale.

Un giorno nella vita di un ingegnere digitale di automazione del caffè

• Servire come esperto tecnico sugli strumenti e le tecnologie digitali e di automazione dell'arte del caffè e costruire capacità organizzative attraverso il treno l'approccio del formatore.

• Guida l'esplorazione e lo sviluppo delle capacità digitali in collaborazione con IT, Zones e partner tecnologici per evolvere continuamente la roadmap Digital & Automation per il caffè.

• Superare l'implementazione e l'adozione della roadmap Digital & Automation in zone e operazioni, garantendo un trasferimento tecnologico efficace e un'implementazione sostenibile.

• Guidare e valutare tecnicamente le prove del concetto, valutare i miglioramenti e sostenere la scala di successo di tecnologie convalidate.

• Stabilire e mantenere gli standard tecnologici digitali e di automazione, assicurando l'allineamento in zone e promuovendo la migliore condivisione pratica in tutta la rete di produzione di caffè.

Che cosa vi farà successo

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee (NPTC Coffee) is the leading R&D organization that discovers, develops and deploys coffee and beverage products and technologies for in-home and out-of-home consumption. It consists of units in Konolfingen (CH), Marysville (USA), Orbe (CH) and Singapore and provides new products and processes to all Nestlé markets worldwide.

Our mission – to delight the consumer wherever, whenever, however by delivering moments of genuine pleasure and indulgence - drives the need for us to attract, select and develop the right people for the right jobs throughout the value chain of our business.

Position Snapshot

Location: Orbe, Switzerland

Company: Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee
Act. Rate: Full-Time Act. Rate 100%
Type of contract: Permanent contract

Start date: As soon as possible

Deadline for applications: 28 / 02 /2026

Position Summary

As a Coffee Automation Digital Engineer , you will lead and drive digital technology exploration and technology transfer to industrialization within the coffee category, ensuring the integration of innovative solutions that enhance operational efficiency and product development. This is an amazing opportunity to drive innovation and have a direct impact on advancing the digital and automation agenda for the manufacturing technologies of Nestlé at global scale.

A Day in the Life of a Coffee Automation Digital Engineer

• Serve as the technical expert on state of the art digital and automation tools and technologies used in coffee and build organisational capability through the train the trainer approach.

• Lead the exploration and development of digital capabilities in collaboration with IT, Zones, and technology partners to continuously evolve the Digital & Automation roadmap for coffee.

• Oversee the deployment and adoption of the Digital & Automation roadmap across Zones and operations, ensuring effective technology transfer and sustainable implementation.

• Drive and technically evaluate proofs of concept, assessing improvements and supporting the successful scale up of validated technologies.

• Establish and maintain digital and automation technology standards, ensuring alignment across Zones and promoting best practice sharing throughout the coffee manufacturing network.

What will make you successful

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Software, Telecommunications engineering, Automation or equivalent

• Extensive experience in R&D, Data Analytics, Automation, Industrial IT, or software engineering

• Advanced technical knowledge in Data Analytics, Software Development, or Automation

• Proven track record of successful project execution and technology implementation, with strong project and change management capabilities

• Experience leading cross-functional teams effectively with excellent communication & interpersonal skills.

• Proficient in user-centered design and agile methodologies, with the ability to adapt to evolving project requirements is a strong plus

• Strong curiosity and passion for innovation with a hands-on attitude

• Courage to challenge the status quo with a strong collaborative mindset

• Languages : Fluency in English, and other language considered a plus

Nestlé is committed to the accessibility of its recruitment process. If you require an adaptation during the recruitment process, please do let us know so we can support you effectively. All information will be treated confidentially.

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference. We do this by fostering a diverse, friendly, supportive, and collaborative environment, that creates positive disruption, embraces innovation, and empowers people and teams to win. We aim to hire friendly, respectful, inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.

Be a force for good. Join Nestlé and visit us on www.nestle.com .

jobs.title: Associate Specialist Functional Microbiome
jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Limited contract until 31.12.2027

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As an Associate Specialist Functional Microbiome at Nestlé Research, your mission is to advance research on microbial metabolites and translate functional microbiome science into meaningful business applications. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, technicians, research assistants, innovation partners and external experts across microbiome, metabolomics, immunology and related fields. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist Functional Microbiome

• Developing research that deepens understanding of microbial metabolites and their role in microbiome-host interactions.

• Translating scientific insights into nutrition, health and petcare applications with business relevance.

• Strengthening scientific approaches that move microbiome research from correlations toward causal understanding.

• Building cross-functional collaboration with internal research teams, technical experts and innovation partners.

• Expanding external scientific networks to identify emerging methods, partners and breakthrough opportunities.

• Sharing high-quality scientific outputs through publications, presentations and clear communication with key stakeholders.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD and recognized scientific expertise in biochemistry, microbiology or metabolism, with a strong focus on microbial metabolites in microbiome-host interactions.

• Applying systems biology, metabolomics and functional microbiome knowledge to generate actionable research insights.

• Using project leadership, stakeholder management and results focus to deliver high-quality research outcomes.

• Collaborating proactively across scientific disciplines while communicating complex ideas with clarity and influence.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

While we already have a strong succession plan for this role, all internal candidates whose skills most closely align with the role’s requirements will be considered. Please discuss your application with your HR Business Partner and line manager before applying.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Company: Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Activity rate: 100%

Target start date: February 2027, flexible
Deadline for applications: 15 October 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

The Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee is a global center of expertise for coffee and beverage innovation. Our teams in Konolfingen, Orbe, Singapore and Marysville lead coffee and beverage research and development for Nestlé markets worldwide.

As a R&D Intern - Soft Matter for Next-Generation Creamer, your mission is to support a research project focused on improving mouthfeel in coffee-based beverages. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with sensory experts, product developers, laboratory teams and international research colleagues to develop and apply analytical methods that help guide recipe optimization. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a R&D Intern - Soft Matter for Next-Generation Creamer

Exploring scientific literature and internal knowledge to build a clear understanding of beverage structure, mouthfeel and creaminess.

• Identifying and testing analytical approaches that help characterize mouthfeel in coffee-based beverages.

• Optimizing and implementing methods that connect laboratory measurements with sensory perception.

• Collaborating with product development and sensory teams to generate insights that support creamer and recipe optimization.

• Creating clear reports, study summaries and practical guidance that help the team apply your learnings beyond the project.

What will make you successful

• Being a student or fresh graduate in Physics, Physical Chemistry, Food Science or a related field

• Being able to connect scientific concepts to practical product challenges.

• Being hands-on, proactive and comfortable experimenting in a laboratory environment while learning by doing.

• Having an analytical mindset and the confidence to interpret data, communicate findings and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

• Fluent in English, French would be an asset.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent contract
Target start date: As soon as possible

Deadline for applications: 6 September 2026

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As an IP Paralegal at Nestlé, your mission is to support Senior Legal Counsels responsible for trademark portfolios and to independently drive intellectual property projects. To support one of our newly integrated Strategic Business Unit, you will play a key role in ensuring strong portfolio management, efficient ways of working and close collaboration with internal business and legal stakeholders. You will make a difference by helping protect and strengthen Nestlé’s brands through accurate trademark searches, portfolio management and legal research.

How you’ll make an impact as an IP Paralegal

• Conducting trademark availability searches, analysing results and making clear recommendations to the responsible Counsel(s).

• Managing trademark and industrial design registration processes from filing to grant for specific Business Unit(s), aligned with business roll-out plans.

• Handling objections from IP Authorities, defensive oppositions and related agreements, undertakings and co-existence terms.

• Monitoring competitive trademark publications, supporting oppositions where needed and drafting reports on moderately complex legal matters.

• Keeping internal records accurate by creating and updating files, docketing deadlines and monitoring key portfolio milestones.

• Supporting legal research, evidence gathering and litigation activities by organising information, sales figures and marketing materials for trademark and design matters.

What will make you successful

• Bringing solid experience in trademarks within an international environment or a law firm.

• Working confidently with online databases and web-based IP management systems, ideally Memotech, or showing strong digital agility to onboard quickly.

• Combining excellent planning and organisational skills with strong accuracy and attention to detail.

• Being flexible, proactive and collaborative, with the curiosity and agility to work autonomously and take initiative.

• Being curious about innovation and comfortable working with digital tools, data analytics and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions, to help drive operational excellence and support the future development of our IP services.

• Communicating fluently in written and spoken English; good spoken French is desirable.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Société des Produits Nestlé S.A., we place people at the heart of everything we do

• Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way across different brands, businesses, functions and regions.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dettagli del lavoro

- Luogo: Vevey, Svizzera - Modello di lavoro: Ibrido / A tempo pieno 100% - Tipo di contratto / durata: Contratto permanente - Data di inizio obiettivo: Appena possibile - Termine ultimo per le domande: 6 settembre 2026

Informazioni sul ruolo

Siate una forza per il bene e accelerate il cambiamento che migliora la vita e il pianeta

Come IP Paralegal di Nestlé, la vostra missione è quella di sostenere i Consulenti Legali Senior responsabili dei portafogli dei marchi e di guidare indipendentemente i progetti di proprietà intellettuale. Per supportare uno dei nostri nuovi Business Unit Strategici integrati, svolgerete un ruolo chiave nel garantire una gestione del portafoglio forte, metodi efficienti di lavoro e una stretta collaborazione con le parti interessate interne del business e del diritto. Farete la differenza aiutando a proteggere e rafforzare i marchi di Nestlé attraverso ricerche accurate sui marchi, gestione del portafoglio e ricerca legale.

Responsabilità

- Condurre ricerche sulla disponibilità dei marchi, analizzare i risultati e formulare raccomandazioni chiare ai Consigli responsabili (s). - Gestire i processi di registrazione dei marchi e del disegno industriale dal deposito alla concessione di specifiche Business Unit (s), in linea con i piani di implementazione delle imprese. - Gestire obiezioni da parte delle autorità IP, opposizioni difensive e relativi accordi, imprese e condizioni di coesistenza. - Monitoraggio delle pubblicazioni dei marchi competitivi, sostegno alle opposizioni laddove necessario e stesura di relazioni su questioni giuridiche moderatamente complesse.

- Mantenere i registri interni precisi creando e aggiornando i file, bloccando le scadenze e monitorando le tappe chiave del portafoglio. - Sostenere le attività di ricerca legale, raccolta di prove e contenzioso organizzando informazioni, dati di vendita e materiali di marketing per i marchi e la progettazione.

Requisiti

- Condurre una solida esperienza in marchi all'interno di un ambiente internazionale o di uno studio legale. - Lavorare con fiducia con database online e sistemi di gestione IP basati sul web, idealmente Memotech, o mostrare una forte agilità digitale a bordo rapidamente. - Combinare eccellenti capacità di pianificazione e organizzazione con una forte precisione e attenzione ai dettagli. - Essere flessibili, proattivi e collaborativi, con la curiosità e l'agilità di lavorare autonomamente e prendere iniziativa.

- Essere curiosi di innovazione e lavorare confortevolmente con strumenti digitali, analisi dei dati e tecnologie emergenti, comprese soluzioni AI-abilitate, per contribuire all'eccellenza operativa e sostenere lo sviluppo futuro dei nostri servizi IP. - Comunicare fluentemente in inglese scritto e parlato; il francese parlato buono è auspicabile. - Demostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

Cosa offriamo

Alla Société des Produits Nestlé S.A., mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo

- Emozionanti opportunità di sviluppare la tua carriera attraverso diversi marchi, imprese, funzioni e regioni. - Arrangiamenti di lavoro flessibili che facilitano la creatività e la collaborazione. - Una cultura di rispetto, con la diversità, equità e inclusione al suo centro. - Un ambiente internazionale dinamico che ti permette di imparare, sviluppare e crescere.

Processo di assunzione

Il reclutamento sarà guidato dalla vestibilità tra le competenze individuali e le esigenze del ruolo. Ogni candidato le cui competenze corrispondono alle esigenze del lavoro sarà considerato. Ci impegniamo per un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli se necessario.

Se avete bisogno di un adattamento durante il processo di reclutamento, vi preghiamo di farci sapere in modo che possiamo supportarvi in modo efficace. Tutte le informazioni saranno trattate in modo confidenziale.

Il processo di assunzione include tipicamente un'intervista con l'acquisizione di un terreno, un'intervista con il team di noleggio, e una discussione finale e offerta.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Aufgabenbeschreibung

- Standort: Vevey, Schweiz - Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid / Vollzeit 100% - Vertragstyp / Laufzeit: Festanstellung - Zielstartdatum: So schnell wie möglich - Bewerbungsfrist: 6. September 2026

Über die Rolle

Sei eine Kraft für Gutes und beschleunige den Wandel, der Leben und den Planeten verbessert

Als IP-Paralegal bei Nestlé ist es Ihre Aufgabe, Senior Legal Counsels zu unterstützen, die für Markenportfolios verantwortlich sind, und selbstständig Projekte im Bereich geistiges Eigentum zu fördern. Um eines unserer neu integrierten strategischen Geschäftsbereiche zu unterstützen, spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Sicherstellung eines starken Portfoliomanagements, effizienter Arbeitsweisen und der engen Zusammenarbeit mit internen Unternehmen und rechtlichen Akteuren. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie Nestlés Marken durch genaue Markenrecherchen, Portfoliomanagement und Rechtsforschung schützen und stärken.

Zuständigkeiten

- Durchführung von Markenverfügbarkeitsrecherchen, Analyse der Ergebnisse und klare Empfehlungen an die zuständigen Berater. - Verwaltung von Marken- und Industriedesign-Registrierungsprozessen von der Einreichung bis zur Erteilung für bestimmte Business Unit(s), abgestimmt auf Business Roll-out-Pläne. - Umgang mit Einwänden von IP-Behörden, Abwehrgegnern und damit verbundenen Vereinbarungen, Unternehmen und Koexistenz Begriffe. - Überwachung von Wettbewerbsmarkenveröffentlichungen, Unterstützung von Oppositionen, wenn erforderlich und Ausarbeitung von Berichten über mäßig komplexe rechtliche Fragen.

- Interne Aufzeichnungen korrekt zu halten, indem Dateien erstellt und aktualisiert werden, Fristen zu dotieren und wichtige Meilensteine im Portfolio zu überwachen. - Unterstützung der rechtlichen Forschung, der Evidenzsammlung und der Prozessaktivitäten durch die Organisation von Informationen, Verkaufszahlen und Marketingmaterialien für Marken- und Designangelegenheiten.

Anforderungen

- Solide Erfahrung in Marken innerhalb eines internationalen Umfelds oder einer Anwaltskanzlei. - Sicheres Arbeiten mit Online-Datenbanken und webbasierten IP-Management-Systemen, idealerweise Memotech, oder zeigt starke digitale Agilität, um schnell an Bord. - Herausragende Planungs- und Organisationsfähigkeiten mit hoher Genauigkeit und Liebe zum Detail zu kombinieren. - Flexibel, proaktiv und kollaborativ, mit der Neugier und Agilität, autonom zu arbeiten und Initiative zu ergreifen.

- Neugierig sein über Innovation und komfortables Arbeiten mit digitalen Tools, Datenanalyse und neuen Technologien, einschließlich KI-fähige Lösungen, um die operative Exzellenz zu fördern und die zukünftige Entwicklung unserer IP-Dienste zu unterstützen. - fließend in Englisch und gesprochen zu kommunizieren; gut gesprochenes Französisch ist wünschenswert. - Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Schnelligkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen zu demonstrieren.

Was wir anbieten

In der Société des Produits Nestlé S.A. stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

- Spannende Möglichkeiten, Ihre Karriere über verschiedene Marken, Unternehmen, Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zu entwickeln. - Flexible Arbeitsvereinbarungen, die Kreativität und Zusammenarbeit erleichtern. - Eine Kultur des Respekts, mit Vielfalt, Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion im Kern. - Ein dynamisches internationales Umfeld, das Sie befähigt, zu lernen, zu entwickeln und zu wachsen.

Einmietung

Die Rekrutierung wird durch die Passform zwischen den einzelnen Kompetenzen und den Anforderungen der Rolle angetrieben. Jeder Kandidat, dessen Fähigkeiten den Anforderungen des Jobs entsprechen, wird berücksichtigt. Wir sind zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen Einstellungserfahrung verpflichtet und freuen uns, bei Bedarf angemessene Unterkünfte zu bieten.

Wenn Sie eine Anpassung während des Rekrutierungsprozesses benötigen, lassen Sie uns bitte wissen, damit wir Sie effektiv unterstützen können. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam, eine abschließende Diskussion und Angebot. Wir überprüfen die Bewerbungen, wie sie empfangen werden und schließen die Rolle einmal
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Détails de l'emploi

- Lieu: Vevey, Suisse - Modèle de travail: Hybride / Temps plein 100% - Type de contrat / durée: Contrat permanent - Date de début cible: Dès que possible - Date limite pour les candidatures: 6 septembre 2026

À propos du rôle

Être une force pour le bien et accélérer le changement qui améliore les vies et la planète

En tant que parajuriste en propriété intellectuelle chez Nestlé, votre mission est de soutenir les conseillers juridiques principaux responsables des portefeuilles de marques et de conduire des projets de propriété intellectuelle de façon indépendante. Pour soutenir l'une de nos nouvelles unités stratégiques intégrées, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la gestion de portefeuille solide, des méthodes efficaces de travail et une collaboration étroite avec les intervenants internes en affaires et juridiques.

Responsabilités

- Effectuer des recherches sur la disponibilité des marques, analyser les résultats et formuler des recommandations claires au ou aux conseillers responsables. - Gérer les processus d'enregistrement des marques et des dessins et modèles industriels, du dépôt à la délivrance de licences pour des unités commerciales spécifiques, en conformité avec les plans de déploiement des entreprises. - Traitement des objections des autorités de propriété intellectuelle, des oppositions défensives et des accords connexes, des engagements et des conditions de coexistence. - Suivi des publications concurrentielles sur les marques, soutien des oppositions au besoin et rédaction de rapports sur des questions juridiques modérément complexes.

- Maintenir des dossiers internes précis en créant et en mettant à jour des dossiers, en fixant des délais et en surveillant les étapes clés du portefeuille. - Soutenir les activités de recherche juridique, de collecte de preuves et de litige en organisant des informations, des chiffres de vente et des documents de marketing pour les questions de marques et de dessins et modèles.

Besoins

- Avoir une solide expérience en matière de marques dans un environnement international ou un cabinet d'avocats. - Travailler avec confiance avec des bases de données en ligne et des systèmes de gestion de la propriété intellectuelle basés sur le Web, idéalement Mémotech, ou faire preuve d'une grande agilité numérique pour s'y rendre rapidement. - Être flexible, proactif et collaboratif, avec la curiosité et l'agilité de travailler de façon autonome et de prendre des initiatives.

- Être curieux de l'innovation et de l'aise avec les outils numériques, l'analyse des données et les technologies émergentes, y compris les solutions adaptées à l'IA, pour contribuer à stimuler l'excellence opérationnelle et soutenir le développement futur de nos services de propriété intellectuelle. - Communiquer couramment en anglais écrit et parlé; le français parlé est souhaitable. - Démontrer le courage, la collaboration, la rapidité et l'apprentissage continu.

Ce que nous offrons

Chez Société des produits Nestlé S.A., nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons

- Des possibilités de développer votre carrière dans différentes marques, entreprises, fonctions et régions. - Des modalités de travail flexibles qui facilitent la créativité et la collaboration. - Une culture de respect, avec diversité, équité et inclusion au cœur de ses préoccupations. - Un environnement international dynamique qui vous donne les moyens d'apprendre, de développer et de grandir.

Processus d'embauche

Le recrutement sera motivé par l'adéquation entre les compétences individuelles et les exigences du rôle. Chaque candidat dont les compétences correspondent aux exigences du poste sera pris en considération. Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin.

Si vous avez besoin d'une adaptation pendant le processus de recrutement, veuillez nous en informer afin que nous puissions vous soutenir efficacement.

Le processus d'embauche comprend habituellement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales.

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen , Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and help nurture a healthier generation

As a Senior Manufacturing Specialist, your mission is to lead manufacturing support for innovation and renovation projects, providing technical and operational expertise that enables successful industrialization and sustainable factory performance. At our research and development center in Konolfingen, Switzerland, we develop science-proven nutrition products, processes and packaging, while providing technical support to Nestlé factories worldwide. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with research and development teams, businesses, markets, factories, suppliers and external partners. This is your opportunity to grow your expertise and help improve lives through nutrition innovation worldwide.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Manufacturing Specialist

• Leading manufacturing support across innovation and renovation projects to turn promising concepts into competitive products, processes and systems

• Driving early manufacturing input, risk assessment and technical decisions that improve readiness, speed and implementation quality

• Delivering reliable technical assistance during industrialization, start-ups and product launches to achieve efficient, sustainable factory performance

• Building and documenting specialist knowledge, standards and guidelines that strengthen manufacturing capability across sites

• Exploring breakthrough technologies and processes that create new opportunities for innovation, productivity and competitive advantage

• Developing factory knowledge through training, coaching and networks that accelerate learning and cross-site collaboration

What will make you successful

• Bringing deep manufacturing, engineering or product development expertise to industrialization and factory support

• Applying current quality, safety and hygiene standards to deliver robust and sustainable solutions

• Using data analysis, digital tools and structured problem solving to identify risks and improve performance

• Collaborating across functions, sites and cultures while communicating technical recommendations clearly to varied audiences

• Communicating fluently in English

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.
