descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Temporary – 12 months
Target start date: Q1 2027, flexible
Deadline for applications: 16 October 2026

Be a force for good and take your NeStep with Nestlé

NeStep is a unique 12-month immersive experience at Nestlé in Switzerland for fresh graduates who want to learn fast, grow with purpose and make an impact. From day one, you spend at least half of your time owning one impactful project, combined with structured learning and continuous mentoring to deliver meaningful results.

As a NeStep talent in Packaging Innovation at the Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee, your mission is to support the development and implementation of more sustainable paper-based packaging solutions for coffee products while helping deliver a superior consumer experience. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with packaging specialists, project teams, internal research and development partners, marketing, business teams, operations, laboratories and external suppliers. This is your opportunity to learn by doing, grow with support and shape the future you envision for yourself and for the world around you.

How you’ll make an impact as a NeStep talent in Packaging Innovation

• Supporting the development and implementation of innovative paper-based packaging solutions for coffee products, including flexible and rigid formats.

• Contributing to packaging material changes from plastic to paper while helping maintain functionality, quality and consumer experience.

• Coordinating laboratory activities, technical testing and trials, then turning results into clear summaries and recommendations for project teams.

• Collaborating with internal partners and external suppliers to explore new materials, packaging formats and technical solutions.

• Creating mock-ups, prototypes, sketches or renderings that bring new packaging concepts to life and support decision-making.

What will make you successful

• Master’s graduate in Packaging Engineering, Materials Science, Industrial Design or a related field, with a strong interest in packaging innovation.

• Being agile, organized and proactive, with the ability to manage several activities, adapt to evolving priorities and turn technical information into clear insights.

• Having strong collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to work with laboratories, project teams, business partners and suppliers.

• Having fluency in English; French is an asset.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

Eligibility criteria

• Being a recent graduate from a Swiss higher education institution (bachelor's or master's degree completed within last 12 months).

• Swiss nationals, EU/EFTA nationals, or C permit holders only.

At Nestlé , we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities, including mentoring and coaching

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

• Potential reward for outstanding contribution

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to learn, grow and be a force for good?

Apply now and take your NeStep with Nestlé.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Standort: Orbe, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid
Vertragsart/Dauer: Befristet – 12 Monate
Zielstartdatum: Q1 2027, flexibel
Bewerbungsfrist: 16. Oktober 2026

Seien Sie eine Kraft für das Gute und nehmen Sie Ihren NeStep mit Nestlé

NeStep ist eine einzigartige 12-monatige immersive Erfahrung bei Nestlé in der Schweiz für frische Absolventen, die schnell lernen, mit dem Ziel wachsen und etwas bewirken wollen. Vom ersten Tag an verbringen Sie mindestens die Hälfte Ihrer Zeit mit einem wirkungsvollen Projekt, kombiniert mit strukturiertem Lernen und kontinuierlichem Mentoring, um sinnvolle Ergebnisse zu liefern.

Als NeStep-Talent für Verpackungsinnovation im Nestlé Product Technology Center für Kaffee ist es Ihre Mission, die Entwicklung und Implementierung nachhaltigerer papierbasierter Verpackungslösungen für Kaffeeprodukte zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig ein überlegenes Verbrauchererlebnis zu bieten. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Verpackungsspezialisten, Projektteams, internen Forschungs- und Entwicklungspartnern, Marketing, Geschäftsteams, Betrieb, Labors und externen Lieferanten zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, zu lernen, mit Unterstützung zu wachsen und die Zukunft zu gestalten, die Sie sich für sich selbst und für die Welt um Sie herum vorstellen.

Wie Sie als NeStep-Talent in der Verpackungsinnovation etwas bewirken können

• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer papierbasierter Verpackungslösungen für Kaffeeprodukte, einschließlich flexibler und starrer Formate.

• Der Beitrag zum Verpackungsmaterial ändert sich von Kunststoff zu Papier und trägt gleichzeitig dazu bei, Funktionalität, Qualität und Verbrauchererfahrung zu erhalten.

• Koordinieren von Laboraktivitäten, technischen Tests und Versuchen, anschließend werden die Ergebnisse in klare Zusammenfassungen und Empfehlungen für Projektteams umgewandelt.

• Zusammenarbeit mit internen Partnern und externen Lieferanten, um neue Materialien, Verpackungsformate und technische Lösungen zu erforschen.

• Erstellen von Mock-ups, Prototypen, Skizzen oder Renderings, die neue Verpackungskonzepte zum Leben erwecken und die Entscheidungsfindung unterstützen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Master-Absolvent in Verpackungstechnik, Materialwissenschaft, Industriedesign oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit einem starken Interesse an Verpackungsinnovation.

• Agil, organisiert und proaktiv sein, mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Aktivitäten zu verwalten, sich an sich ändernde Prioritäten anzupassen und technische Informationen in klare Einblicke zu verwandeln.

• Mit starken Kooperations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit dem Vertrauen, mit Labors, Projektteams, Geschäftspartnern und Lieferanten zusammenzuarbeiten.

• fließend Englisch; Französisch ist ein Asset.

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen.

Förderkriterien

• Absolvent einer Schweizer Hochschule (Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in den letzten 12 Monaten).

• Schweizer Staatsangehörige, EU/EFTA-Staatsangehörige oder C-Genehmigungsinhaber nur.

Bei Nestlé stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für bürobasierte Rollen)

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, einschließlich Mentoring und Coaching

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

• Potenzielle Belohnung für ausstehenden Beitrag

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird die Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit zu lernen, zu wachsen und eine Kraft für das Gute zu sein?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und nehmen Sie Ihren NeStep mit Nestlé.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: Orbe, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Hybride
Type / durée du contrat : Temporaire – 12 mois
Date cible de début : T1 2027, flexible
Date limite de dépôt des candidatures: 16 octobre 2026

Soyez une force pour le bien et prenez votre NeStep avec Nestlé

NeStep est une expérience immersive unique de 12 mois à Nestlé en Suisse pour les nouveaux diplômés qui veulent apprendre rapidement, grandir avec le but et faire un impact. Depuis le premier jour, vous passez au moins la moitié de votre temps à posséder un projet qui a un impact, combiné à l'apprentissage structuré et au mentorat continu pour obtenir des résultats significatifs.

En tant que talent NeStep pour l'innovation en matière d'emballage au Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee, votre mission est de soutenir le développement et la mise en œuvre de solutions d'emballage papier plus durables pour les produits du café tout en offrant une expérience de consommation supérieure. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec les spécialistes de l'emballage, les équipes de projet, les partenaires internes de recherche et développement, le marketing, les équipes d'affaires, les opérations, les laboratoires et les fournisseurs externes. C'est l'occasion d'apprendre en faisant, de grandir avec le soutien et de façonner l'avenir que vous envisagez pour vous-même et pour le monde qui vous entoure.

Comment vous allez faire un impact comme un talent NeStep dans l'emballage innovation

• Soutenir le développement et la mise en œuvre de solutions innovantes d'emballage sur papier pour les produits du café, y compris des formats souples et rigides.

• Contribuer aux changements de matériaux d'emballage du plastique au papier tout en aidant à maintenir la fonctionnalité, la qualité et l'expérience du consommateur.

• Coordonner les activités de laboratoire, les essais techniques et les essais, puis transformer les résultats en résumés clairs et en recommandations pour les équipes de projet.

• Collaborer avec des partenaires internes et des fournisseurs externes pour explorer de nouveaux matériaux, formats d'emballage et solutions techniques.

• Créer des maquettes, des prototypes, des croquis ou des rendus qui donnent vie à de nouveaux concepts d'emballage et appuient la prise de décisions.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Maîtrise en Ingénierie de l'emballage, Sciences des matériaux, Design industriel ou un domaine connexe, avec un grand intérêt pour l'innovation de l'emballage.

• Être agile, organisé et proactif, avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs activités, s'adapter à l'évolution des priorités et transformer l'information technique en clair aperçu.

• Avoir des compétences solides en collaboration et en communication, avec confiance pour travailler avec les laboratoires, les équipes de projet, les partenaires commerciaux et les fournisseurs.

• Avoir la maîtrise de l'anglais; le français est un atout.

• Démontrer le courage, la collaboration, la rapidité et l'apprentissage continu, tout en transformant les idées en un impact mesurable et en créant une valeur partagée.

Critères d'éligibilité

• Être récemment diplômé d'un établissement d'enseignement supérieur suisse (maîtrise ou baccalauréat obtenu au cours des 12 derniers mois).

• Les ressortissants suisses, les ressortissants de l'UE/AELE ou les titulaires de permis C seulement.

Chez Nestlé, on place les gens au cœur de tout ce qu'on fait

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement, y compris le mentorat et l'encadrement

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

• Récompense potentielle pour contribution exceptionnelle

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend habituellement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé ne communiquera qu'avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à apprendre, grandir et être une force pour le bien?

Faites votre demande dès maintenant et prenez votre NeStep avec Nestlé.

jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Technician in Lipids & Metabolic Analytics department at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide analytical support in lipids analytics and deliver timely, high-quality data that supports research, innovation, and operational needs. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, experts, peers across analytical groups, and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Technician in Lipids Analytics

• Delivering timely, high-quality lipid data that advances research projects and supports operational priorities.

• Executing lipid extraction and chromatography experiments with accuracy, and rigor.

• Implementing analytical methods and technical solutions that improve lipid analysis capabilities.

• Advancing innovation by exploring and applying new analytical technologies that expand what is possible in lipids analytics.

What will make you successful

• Bringing knowledge in lipid classes, lipid extraction, and the analysis of lipophilic compounds with a similar position in industry or in academia.

• Applying knowledge of gas chromatography and liquid chromatography methods to deliver precise analytical results.

• Collaborating with a quality-focused, proactive and curiosity mindset while working confidently across diverse teams and stakeholders.

• Communicating fluently in French and English is a plus.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

Chez Nespresso Suisse nous pensons qu’il est possible d’élever l’univers du café et nous voulons contribuer positivement à changer les vies et les paysages pour le mieux. Élu meilleur employeur 2025, nous plaçons chacun de nos 14 000 collaborateurs, sans exception, au cœur de notre réussite. Pour y parvenir, nous adoptons quatre comportements essentiels : « We Inspire, we Care, we Act, and we iNnovate ». Et vous ? Voulez-vous nous accompagner dans cette aventure passionnante ? Rejoignez l’équipe Nespresso ! Et réimaginez la nature du café. Réimaginez votre avenir.

Instantané du poste

Lieu : Romont, Switzerland

Entité : Centre de Production Nespresso
Taux : Temps plein 100%

Type de contrat : Contrat indéterminé

Ce que nous offrons chez Nespresso

De réelles opportunités d’évolution de carrière et de développement personnel

descriptionByLocale.it:

Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, adottiamo quattro comportamenti essenziali: "Noi ispiriamo, curiamo, agiamo, e iNnovate". E tu? Vuoi accompagnarci in questa emozionante avventura? Unisciti al team Nespresso! E immagina la natura del caffè. Ricomincia il tuo futuro.

Messaggio istantaneo

Ubicazione: Romont, Svizzera

Entità: Centro di produzione Nespresso

Opportunità reali per lo sviluppo della carriera e lo sviluppo personale

Un quadro flessibile per la creatività e la collaborazione

Una cultura basata sulla benevolenza e sull'inclusione, dove ognuno può essere se stesso

Qualità e sostenibilità nel cuore della nostra identità e una visione essenziale per un cambiamento positivo L'opportunità di lavorare per una società certificata B Corp, e uno dei marchi più affidabili e apprezzati in tutto il mondo.

Come 4x8 (M/F/D) Roasting Operator, sarete responsabili del funzionamento degli impianti di tostatura.

Una giornata nella vita di un team di Roasting Operator 4x8 (M/F/D)

• Condurre i servizi di roasting

• Assicurarsi che tutte le linee sono fornite con caffè secondo il piano di produzione

• Controllare il funzionamento dei dispositivi di tostatura e mantenere le installazioni

• Anticipare e rispondere in modo appropriato agli eventi che riguardano la sicurezza, la qualità, le prestazioni e la perdita

• Assicurare la trasmissione di informazioni seguendo il calendario del passaggio da team a team

• Partecipa al miglioramento continuo nell'ambito della struttura di miglioramento in corso in atto.

I vostri beni per il successo

• CFC in un campo tecnico o alimentare

• Esperienza come pilota di linea (o simile) nell'industria alimentare o farmaceutica

In un team diversificato di oltre 90 nazionalità in 58 paesi, è possibile partecipare a questa cultura innovativa, in cui le persone si sostengono e si aiutano a vicenda. Una cultura in cui tutti sono incoraggiati a mettere in discussione lo status quo e ad avere un impatto sul futuro di una delle più grandi aziende sostenibili del mondo. Qualunque ruolo tu abbia, scoprirai che puoi davvero cambiare le cose e condividerle.

Elected the best employer 2025, we place each of our 14,000 employees, without exception, at the heart of our success. To achieve this, we adopt four essential behaviours: "We Inspire, we Care, we Act, and we iNnovate". And you? Would you like to accompany us on this exciting adventure? Join the Nespresso team! And imagine the nature of the coffee. Reimagin your future.

Instant post

Location: Romont, Switzerland

Entity: Nespresso Production Centre
Rate: Full time 100%

Type of contract: Undetermined contract

What we offer at Nespresso

Real opportunities for career development and personal development

A flexible framework for creativity and collaboration

A culture based on benevolence and inclusiveness, where everyone can be himself

Quality and sustainability at the heart of our identity and an essential vision for positive change The opportunity to work for a B Corp certified company, and one of the most reliable and appreciated brands worldwide.

Discover our trades: Nespresso trades - YouTube

Summary of the post

As a 4x8 (M/F/D) Roasting Operator, you will be responsible for the operation of roasting plants.

A day in the life of a Roasting Operator 4x8 team (M/F/D)

• Conducting Roasting Facilities

• Ensure that all lines are supplied with coffee according to the production plan

• Control the operation of roasting devices and maintain the installations

• Anticipate and respond appropriately to events affecting safety, quality, performance and loss

• Ensure the transmission of information by following the schedule of the shift from team to team

• Participate in continuous improvement as part of the ongoing improvement structure in place.

Your assets for success

• CFCs in a technical or food field

• Experience as a line driver (or similar) in the food or pharmaceutical industry

• Experience in roasting or as a process operator, an asset

• Mastery of French

• Mastery of standard IT tools.

Benefits

• 5 weeks of vacation

• Opportunities for internal training and development

• Pension fund with excellent employer contributions

• Financial contribution to health insurance

• Beneficial parenting policy

• Business restaurant on site with menus at subsidized prices

• Free parking and charging stations for electric cars

• Many advantages at the Nespresso Club

At Nespresso, we built a culture based on benevolence and inclusion, where everyone can be themselves, while growing with the company. We innovate, we dare try new things, we learn and evolve in a digital and connected environment where everything goes very quickly. In a diverse team of more than 90 nationalities in 58 countries, you can take part in this innovative culture, in which people support and help each other. A culture in which everyone is encouraged to question the status quo and have an impact on the future of one of the world's largest sustainable companies. Whatever role you play, you will discover that you can really change things and share them.

Eine Kultur, die auf Wohlwollen und Inklusivität basiert, in der jeder er selbst sein kann

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Linien gemäß dem Produktionsplan mit Kaffee versorgt werden

• Kontrolle des Betriebs der Röstgeräte und Wartung der Anlagen

• Beteiligen Sie sich an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung als Teil der laufenden Verbesserungsstruktur.

• FCKW in einem technischen oder Lebensmittelbereich

• Beherrschung von Französisch

• Beherrschung von Standard-IT-Tools.

• Business Restaurant vor Ort mit Menüs zu subventionierten Preisen

Bei Nespresso haben wir eine Kultur aufgebaut, die auf Wohlwollen und Inklusion basiert, in der jeder selbst sein kann und gleichzeitig mit dem Unternehmen wächst. In einem vielfältigen Team von mehr als 90 Nationalitäten in 58 Ländern können Sie an dieser innovativen Kultur teilnehmen, in der sich Menschen gegenseitig unterstützen und helfen. Eine Kultur, in der jeder ermutigt wird, den Status quo in Frage zu stellen und die Zukunft eines der größten nachhaltigen Unternehmen der Welt zu beeinflussen. Egal welche Rolle du spielst, du wirst entdecken, dass du Dinge wirklich verändern und teilen kannst.

jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: 2 years limited contract

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Junior Research Assistant in Packaging Safety at Nestlé Research, your mission is to develop, validate and apply analytical methods for novel coated paper packaging materials. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with teammates, research colleagues, operations teams, quality managers and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Junior Research Assistant in Packaging Safety

• Contribute to the development of robust analytical methods that help assess the safety and performance of innovative packaging materials.

• Perform packaging characterization analyses that support reliable research outcomes and project decisions.

• Consolidating and interpreting data and writing clear analytical documentation that enables quality, research and project teams to act with confidence.

• Participate in transferring analytical methods to operations and supporting end users throughout the method lifecycle.

• Contributing to quality, safety and knowledge-sharing practices that help teams work consistently across sites.

• Engage with internal and external partners to stay at the forefront of packaging safety science and analytical technologies.

What will make you successful

• Master’s degree in chemistry, analytical chemistry or a related scientific discipline, combined with a strong interest in analytical sciences, packaging safety and sustainable packaging technologies.

• Applying knowledge of gas chromatography-mass spectrometry, liquid chromatography-high resolution mass spectrometry or material characterization.

• Using hands-on laboratory experience from academic projects, internships or research activities to deliver reliable experimental work.

• Collaborating with curiosity, attention to detail and strong data analysis, problem-solving and scientific reporting skills.

• Working proficiency in English and French.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di assistente di ricerca junior nel settore della sicurezza dell'imballaggio presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di sviluppare, convalidare e applicare metodi analitici per nuovi materiali di confezionamento di carta rivestita. Farete la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con compagni di squadra, colleghi di ricerca, team operativi, manager di qualità e partner esterni. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come assistente di ricerca junior nella sicurezza dei pacchetti

• Contribuisci allo sviluppo di robusti metodi analitici che aiutano a valutare la sicurezza e le prestazioni dei materiali di imballaggio innovativi.

• Eseguire analisi di caratterizzazione degli imballaggi che supportano risultati di ricerca affidabili e decisioni di progetto.

• Consolidare e interpretare i dati e scrivere una chiara documentazione analitica che consente ai team di qualità, ricerca e progetto di agire con fiducia.

• Partecipare a trasferire metodi analitici alle operazioni e sostenere gli utenti finali durante il ciclo di vita del metodo.

• Contribuire a pratiche di qualità, sicurezza e condivisione delle conoscenze che aiutano i team a lavorare in modo coerente su siti.

• Impegnarsi con partner interni ed esterni per rimanere in prima linea nella scienza della sicurezza degli imballaggi e nelle tecnologie analitiche.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Laurea magistrale in chimica, chimica analitica o disciplina scientifica correlata, unita ad un forte interesse per le scienze analitiche, la sicurezza degli imballaggi e le tecnologie di imballaggio sostenibili.

• Applicando la conoscenza della spettrometria gascromatografia-massa, della spettrometria di massa della cromatografia liquida-alta risoluzione o della caratterizzazione del materiale.

• Utilizzando esperienza di laboratorio pratica da progetti accademici, stage o attività di ricerca per fornire un lavoro sperimentale affidabile.

• Collaborando con curiosità, attenzione ai dettagli e forte analisi dei dati, problem solving e capacità di reportistica scientifica.

• Competenza di lavoro in inglese e francese.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva e orientata al benessere.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione include tipicamente un video intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che un forte elenco di candidati pertinenti è identificato, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Junior Research Assistant in Packaging Safety bei Nestlé Research besteht Ihre Mission darin, Analysemethoden für neuartige beschichtete Papierverpackungsmaterialien zu entwickeln, zu validieren und anzuwenden. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Teamkollegen, Forschungskollegen, Betriebsteams, Qualitätsmanagern und externen Partnern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Junior Research Assistant in Packaging Safety etwas bewirken können

• Beitrag zur Entwicklung robuster Analysemethoden zur Bewertung der Sicherheit und Leistung innovativer Verpackungsmaterialien.

• Führen Sie Verpackungscharakterisierungsanalysen durch, die zuverlässige Forschungsergebnisse und Projektentscheidungen unterstützen.

• Konsolidierung und Interpretation von Daten und Erstellung einer klaren analytischen Dokumentation, die Qualitäts-, Forschungs- und Projektteams ein vertrauensvolles Handeln ermöglicht.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Übertragung von Analysemethoden auf den Betrieb und unterstützen Sie die Endnutzer während des gesamten Methodenlebenszyklus.

• Beitrag zu Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Wissensaustauschpraktiken, die Teams dabei helfen, standortübergreifend konsequent zu arbeiten.

• Engagieren Sie sich mit internen und externen Partnern, um an der Spitze der Verpackungssicherheitswissenschaft und der Analysetechnologien zu bleiben.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Master-Abschluss in Chemie, analytischer Chemie oder einer verwandten wissenschaftlichen Disziplin, kombiniert mit einem starken Interesse an analytischen Wissenschaften, Verpackungssicherheit und nachhaltigen Verpackungstechnologien.

• Anwendung von Kenntnissen der Gaschromatographie-Massenspektrometrie, Flüssigkeitschromatographie-hochauflösende Massenspektrometrie oder Materialcharakterisierung.

• Mit praktischer Laborerfahrung aus akademischen Projekten, Praktika oder Forschungsaktivitäten zuverlässige experimentelle Arbeit zu liefern.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Neugier, Liebe zum Detail und starke Datenanalyse, Problemlösung und wissenschaftliche Berichterstattung Fähigkeiten.

• Arbeitskenntnisse in Englisch und Französisch.

• Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise.

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Talent Acquisition Partner at Nestlé, your mission is to identify and attract the talent that enables business growth, innovation, and performance. You will make a difference by designing data-driven hiring strategies, building strong talent pipelines, championing diversity initiatives, and collaborating closely with HR Business Partners, hiring managers, candidates, and external partners. This is your opportunity to influence hiring decisions, create a positive candidate and stakeholder experience, and contribute to Nestlé’s success in Switzerland.

• Lead the full-cycle recruitment process, from candidate attraction and selection to interviewing, assessment, and offer management.

• Design and execute sourcing strategies to build strong, diverse talent pipelines for critical roles.

• Build trusted relationships with HRBPs, hiring managers, and external partners to deliver an excellent candidate and stakeholder experience.

• Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way, across different brands, businesses, functions, and regions.

• Flexible working arrangements that facilitate creativity and collaboration.

• A dynamic international environment empowering you to learn, develop, and grow.

En tant que Technicien Senior Pilot Plant – Technologies laitières et procédés alimentaires chez Nestlé Research, votre mission est de transformer des concepts scientifiques en procédés alimentaires robustes et industrialisables, en renforçant nos capacités dans les procédés laitiers et biotechnologiques et dans le test d’emballages innovants avec l’ensacheuse verticale. Vous ferez la différence en collaborant étroitement avec des scientifiques, chefs de projet, équipes d’ingénierie et de maintenance, de qualité, et de sécurité. • Préparer, réaliser et clôturer des essais pilotes complexes sur les procédés laitiers (UHT) et les procédés alimentaires associés ainsi que sur l’ensachage vertical.

• Apporter un support technique aux projets : choix des équipements, réglages, stratégie d’essais et résolution de problèmes.

• Collaborer avec les scientifiques, ingénieurs et équipes projet pour passer des idées aux essais concrets en Pilot Plant.

• Contribuer à la montée en échelle des procédés et à l’amélioration continue des équipements et méthodes de travail.

• Travailler dans le respect des standards qualité, hygiène, sécurité alimentaire, sécurité et environnement.

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a MROI Insights Expert at Nestlé Global Marketing Analytics , your mission is to turn advanced marketing effectiveness analytics into clear, actionable insights that help markets optimize media, trade and marketing investment. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with Group Marketing Analytics, technology teams, local marketing, media and consumer insight teams, zone leads, global media and finance partners. This is an opportunity to help shape and elevate a growing global function, build marketing effectiveness capabilities across the business, and make an impact at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a MROI Insights Expert

• Leading the translation of marketing mix modelling, statistics and analytics into simple, compelling insights that shape strategic brand and investment decisions.

• Building clear insight stories, recommendations and business cases that help local teams, zones, SBUs and brand teams improve marketing return on investment.

• Facilitating workshops and presentations with local markets, BEOs, zone marketing teams, Nespresso and global stakeholders to translate insights into action.

• Partnering with the data science team to validate modelling outputs, understand the value behind the analysis and identify opportunities to enhance the capability over time.

• Driving adoption of global marketing effectiveness solutions by partnering with markets, zones and global teams across diverse business contexts.

• Supporting capability development by creating learning content and practical guidance that help business teams use marketing effectiveness insights with confidence.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in marketing analytics, marketing effectiveness and marketing mix modelling within an agency, advertiser or global business environment.

• Applying a clear understanding of marketing, media, pricing and promotion models to turn complex analysis into practical business recommendations.

• Using advanced presentation, spreadsheet and business intelligence tools to create insight-led stories for senior stakeholders.

• Showing initiative, autonomy and flexibility in a fast-moving environment, while taking ownership and responsibility for delivering high-quality outcomes.

• Looking for opportunities to improve, contributing new ideas and generating trust through strong collaboration, transparency and teamwork.

• Communicating fluently and confidently in English, with the ability to present clear insights to senior stakeholders.

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

jobs.title: Demand & Supply Planner

titleByLocale.it: Pianificatore di domanda e di alimentazione

jobs.description:
Position snapshot

Nestlé Waters, Switzerland, Henniez

Permanent Contract

80-100%

Position summary

In this role, you will provide Nestlé Waters with the 18-month rolling best estimate of Customer Demand and improve Demand Plan accuracy. Furthermore, you will manage supply of finished products at different warehouses and manage the finished goods produced by co-packers. The main goal will be to enhance the Supply Chain responsiveness in fulfilling customer demand at optimal cost.

A day in a life of a Demand & Supply Planner:

• Ensure supply & availability of products to fulfil deliveries on time, at the right place with the correct freshness at warehouse level

• Use appropriate statistical models and parameters, interpret results to generate accurate base demand forecasts

• Drive fast, appropriate actions to minimize the impact of deviations from the Demand Plan, and communicate the implemented actions to the stakeholders

• Capture, prioritize, analyze and input Generating Demand events; customer, consumer & competitor information

• Provide Generating Demand teams with inputs on a regular basis regarding product launches, portfolio optimization, rationale of commercial decisions, promotions and customer behaviour

• Build and maintain good communication and collaboration within both Supply Chain and Generating Demand, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance, in order to deliver and satisfy our customers at optimal costs

• Support different processes within Supply Chain

What makes you successful:

• University Degree with previous internships performed ideally in Supply Chain or Commercial CFC with maturity or equivalent level with at least two years’ experience in a similar position or relevant operational experience in Supply Chain at market/business level

• Strong analytical skills

• Good communication and collaboration skills to deal with different departments (Marketing, Factory, Transport)

• Fluent in French & English any other languages is a plus

• Good command of Excel and SAP experience

jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based / Full time
Contract type / duration: Fixed-term contract (2 years)

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (Fermentation & DSP) at Nestlé Research, your mission is to lead bioprocessing activities that bridge lab-scale discovery and industrial manufacturing through robust fermentation and downstream processing solutions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with pilot plant teams, scientists, engineers, quality and safety specialists, technical experts and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (DSP)

• Leading pilot-scale bioprocess trials that help transform promising research into scalable manufacturing solutions.

• Driving fermentation process development by optimizing media, feeding strategies and key operating parameters for reliable performance.

• Developing downstream processing approaches that improve yield, recovery and product quality.

• Building process understanding through data analysis, automation insights and digital tools that support optimization and reproducibility.

• Contributing to safe, compliant and high-quality pilot plant operations through risk assessment, documentation and continuous improvement.

• Shaping the development of new biotech pilot plant capabilities by translating process needs into practical equipment and facility solutions.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in fermentation, bioprocessing and pilot or industrial-scale operations.

• Applying scale-up, technology transfer and industrialization knowledge to make processes robust and ready for implementation.

• Using analytical thinking, process data and automation tools to troubleshoot, optimize and improve reproducibility.

• Collaborating across research, engineering, operations, quality and safety teams with ownership and a hands-on mindset.

• Communicating confidently and delivering presentations in French or English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Modello di lavoro: Office-based / A tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Contratto a termine fisso (2 anni)

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Ingegnere Bioprocess - Pilot Plant (Fermentation & DSP) presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di condurre attività di bioprocessing che colmano la scoperta su scala di laboratorio e la produzione industriale attraverso soluzioni di fermentazione robuste e di lavorazione a valle. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con team di impianti pilota, scienziati, ingegneri, specialisti della qualità e della sicurezza, esperti tecnici e partner esterni. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come ingegnere del bioprocesso - impianto pilota (DSP)

• Prove di bioprocesso pilota che aiutano a trasformare la ricerca promettente in soluzioni di produzione scalabili.

• Sviluppo del processo di fermentazione di guida ottimizzando i media, le strategie di alimentazione e i parametri di funzionamento chiave per prestazioni affidabili.

• Sviluppare approcci di elaborazione a valle che migliorano la resa, il recupero e la qualità del prodotto.

• Costruire la comprensione del processo attraverso l'analisi dei dati, le intuizioni di automazione e gli strumenti digitali che supportano l'ottimizzazione e la riproducibilità.

• Contribuire a operazioni pilota sicure, conformi e di alta qualità attraverso la valutazione del rischio, la documentazione e il miglioramento continuo.

• Definire lo sviluppo di nuove capacità di impianto pilota biotecnologico, traducendo le esigenze di processo in attrezzature pratiche e soluzioni di impianti.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte esperienza nelle operazioni di fermentazione, bioprocessing e pilota o su scala industriale.

• Applicando conoscenze di scala, trasferimento tecnologico e industrializzazione per rendere i processi robusti e pronti per l'implementazione.

• Utilizzando strumenti di pensiero analitico, elaborare dati e automazione per risolvere i problemi, ottimizzare e migliorare la riproducibilità.

• Collaborare tra team di ricerca, ingegneria, operazioni, qualità e sicurezza con la proprietà e una mentalità pratica.

• Comunicare con fiducia e fornire presentazioni in francese o in inglese.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva e orientata al benessere.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide expertise dans la fermentation, le biotraitement et les opérations pilotes ou industrielles.

jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: On site
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Target start date: December 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

As an R&D Chefs Culinarium Intern at Nestlé Research, you will help bring the future of food to life. Working alongside chefs, scientists and global cross-category teams, you will contribute to the creation of innovative food concepts and tasting experiences that support strategic innovation projects. From recipe conceptualization and culinary prototyping to high-impact tastings and events, you will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of culinary excellence and food innovation.

How you’ll make an impact as an R&D Chefs Culinarium Intern

• Supporting the Culinary Flagship team in delivering memorable strategic tastings, leadership events and product showcases that bring innovation to life.

• Creating and refining culinary prototypes, transforming early concepts into engaging tasting experiences and project recommendations.

• Collaborating with chefs, scientists and cross-functional teams to explore new ideas and contribute to innovation projects.

• Capturing prototypes, recipes and project learnings in operational catalogues and databases to ensure knowledge sharing and continuity.

• Exploring global food cultures, cooking techniques and consumer eating habits to build a deeper understanding of cuisines and culinary trends.

What will make you successful

• Currently pursuing a degree in Culinary Arts, with initial practical kitchen experience and a passion for food, recipe conceptualization, culinary storytelling, and creating memorable food experiences through high-impact presentations, plating, tasting experiences, and prototype creation.

• Curious and enthusiastic about learning how culinary creativity and science come together to develop innovative food products and concepts, with a proactive, self-driven mindset

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken

• Demonstrates adaptability, agility, resilience and a continuous learning mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

Essere una forza per il bene e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario.

In qualità di chef R&D Culinarium Intern di Nestlé Research, vi aiuterà a portare in vita il futuro del cibo. Lavorando insieme a chef, scienziati e team internazionali di cross-categoria, contribuirai alla creazione di concetti alimentari innovativi e di esperienze di degustazione che supportano progetti di innovazione strategica. Dalla concettualizzazione della ricetta e dalla prototipazione culinaria alle degustazioni e agli eventi ad alto impatto, acquisirai esperienza pratica all'incrocio tra eccellenza culinaria e innovazione alimentare.

Come si farà un impatto come R&D Chefs Culinarium Intern

• Sostenere il team Culinary Flagship nel fornire memorabili degustazioni strategiche, eventi di leadership e vetrine di prodotti che portano l'innovazione alla vita.

• Creazione e raffinazione di prototipi culinari, trasformando i primi concetti in esperienze di degustazione coinvolgenti e raccomandazioni di progetto.

• Collaborare con chef, scienziati e team interfunzionali per esplorare nuove idee e contribuire a progetti di innovazione.

• Acquisire prototipi, ricette e apprendimento dei progetti in cataloghi operativi e database per garantire la condivisione e la continuità della conoscenza.

• Esplorare culture alimentari globali, tecniche di cucina e abitudini alimentari dei consumatori per costruire una più profonda comprensione delle cucine e delle tendenze culinarie.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Attualmente perseguendo una laurea in arti culinarie, con esperienza di cucina pratica iniziale e una passione per il cibo, la concettualizzazione delle ricette, la narrazione culinaria, e la creazione di esperienze di cibo memorabili attraverso presentazioni ad alto impatto, la placcatura, le esperienze di degustazione e la creazione di prototipi.

• Curioso ed entusiasta di imparare come la creatività culinaria e la scienza si uniscono per sviluppare prodotti e concetti alimentari innovativi, con una mentalità proattiva e self-driven

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione, con la capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari e multiculturali

• Capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente frenetico

• Fluente in inglese, scritto e parlato

• Dimostra l'adattabilità, l'agilità, la resilienza e una mentalità di apprendimento continua.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Sconti interessanti dei dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione include tipicamente un video intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che un forte elenco di candidati pertinenti è identificato, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto per iniziare il tuo viaggio di carriera con noi?

Applicare ora e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario.

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione

In qualità di Specialist Biostatistician presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di fornire competenze statistiche attraverso gli studi clinici, dalla progettazione di studi e dalla pianificazione di analisi alla programmazione, alla reportistica e alla comunicazione scientifica. Come farete un impatto come specialista Biostatistician

• Fornire competenze statistiche che rafforzano la progettazione di studi clinici, allinea gli obiettivi scientifici con robuste ipotesi statistiche e supporta la generazione di prove per la nutrizione, la nutrizione medica e le attività farmaceutiche.

• Sviluppare protocolli clinici di alta qualità e piani di analisi statistica per sostenere una chiara esecuzione di studio.

• Analizzazioni statistiche di programmazione in R o SAS per fornire risultati accurati, riproducibili e ben organizzati che consentono un processo decisionale sicuro.

• Presentare risultati di sperimentazione clinica in modo chiaro e significativo, aiutando i team a interpretare i risultati e tradurre i dati in prove scientifiche.

• Guidare la qualità, la gestione del rischio e il miglioramento continuo nelle statistiche di prova clinica e nelle pratiche di analisi dei dati.

• Condivisione delle conoscenze e dei colleghi di mentoring per costruire capacità, consistenza ed eccellenza scientifica attraverso il team di biostatistica.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte biostatistica e un'esperienza di sperimentazione clinica per supportare la generazione di prove scientifiche di alta qualità per la nutrizione, la nutrizione medica e le attività farmaceutiche.

• Applicare capacità di pensiero analitico, organizzazione e gestione del progetto per fornire risultati affidabili in un ambiente di ricerca complesso.

• Utilizzando la programmazione statistica così come gli standard di ricerca clinica come ICH GCP, EMA, FDA, linee guida CDISC per sostenere la consegna di studio conforme ed efficace.

• Collaborare con partner scientifici e commerciali attraverso una comunicazione chiara, una curiosità e una mentalità focalizzata sulla qualità.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese.

• Abbracciare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, le domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva, orientata al benessere, per creare valore condiviso.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

Die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen gestalten

Als Spezialist für Biostatistik bei Nestlé Research besteht Ihre Mission darin, statistisches Fachwissen für klinische Studien bereitzustellen, von Studiendesign und Analyseplanung bis hin zu Programmierung, Berichterstattung und wissenschaftlicher Kommunikation. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit klinischen Teams, Studiensponsoren, Projektmanagern, Forschungspartnern und externen Anbietern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Spezialist für Biostatistik etwas bewirken können

• Bereitstellung von statistischem Fachwissen, das das Design klinischer Studien stärkt, wissenschaftliche Ziele an robusten statistischen Hypothesen ausrichtet und die Evidenzerzeugung für Ernährung, medizinische Ernährung und pharmazeutische Vermögenswerte unterstützt.

• Entwicklung hochwertiger klinischer Protokolle und statistischer Analysepläne zur Unterstützung einer klaren Studiendurchführung.

• Programmierung statistischer Analysen in R oder SAS, um genaue, reproduzierbare und gut organisierte Ergebnisse zu liefern, die eine sichere Entscheidungsfindung ermöglichen.

• Präsentieren von klinischen Studienergebnissen in einer klaren und aussagekräftigen Weise, die Teams hilft, Ergebnisse zu interpretieren und Daten in wissenschaftliche Beweise zu übersetzen.

• Förderung der Qualität, des Risikomanagements und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von klinischen Studienstatistiken und Datenanalysepraktiken.

• Austausch von Wissen und Mentoring-Kollegen, um Fähigkeiten, Konsistenz und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz im gesamten Biostatistik-Team aufzubauen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Einbringen starker Biostatistik und klinischer Studienexpertise zur Unterstützung einer qualitativ hochwertigen wissenschaftlichen Evidenzerzeugung für Ernährung, medizinische Ernährung und pharmazeutische Vermögenswerte.

• Anwendung analytischen Denkens, Organisation und Projektmanagement Fähigkeiten, um zuverlässige Ergebnisse in einem komplexen Forschungsumfeld zu liefern.

• Verwendung statistischer Programmierung sowie klinischer Forschungsstandards wie ICH GCP, EMA, FDA und CDISC-Richtlinien zur Unterstützung einer konformen und effektiven Studienabwicklung.

• Zusammenarbeit mit wissenschaftlichen und Geschäftspartnern durch klare Kommunikation, Neugier und eine qualitätsorientierte Denkweise.

• fließend auf Englisch kommunizieren.

• Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise, um gemeinsame Werte zu schaffen.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für bürobasierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Abhängig von der Rolle kann eine Videobewertung enthalten sein. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Façonner l'avenir grâce aux percées scientifiques et à l'innovation

En tant que biostatisticienne spécialiste à Nestlé Research, votre mission est de fournir une expertise statistique à travers les essais cliniques, de la conception d'études et la planification d'analyses à la programmation, l'établissement de rapports et la communication scientifique. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes cliniques, les promoteurs d'études, les gestionnaires de projets, les partenaires de recherche et les fournisseurs externes. C'est l'occasion de transformer les idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les gens, les animaux domestiques et la planète.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste biostatisticien

• Fournir une expertise statistique qui renforce la conception des études cliniques, harmonise les objectifs scientifiques avec des hypothèses statistiques solides et soutient la production de preuves pour la nutrition, la nutrition médicale et les actifs pharmaceutiques.

• Élaborer des protocoles cliniques de haute qualité et des plans d'analyse statistique pour appuyer l'exécution claire des études.

• Programmation d'analyses statistiques en R ou SAS pour obtenir des résultats précis, reproductibles et bien organisés qui permettent une prise de décision confiante.

• Présenter les résultats des essais cliniques de façon claire et significative, en aidant les équipes à interpréter les résultats et à traduire les données en preuves scientifiques.

• Diriger la qualité, la gestion des risques et l'amélioration continue des statistiques des essais cliniques et des pratiques d'analyse des données.

• Partager les connaissances et encadrer les collègues afin de renforcer les capacités, l'uniformité et l'excellence scientifique de l'équipe de biostatistique.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide biostatistique et une expertise en essais cliniques pour soutenir la production de preuves scientifiques de haute qualité pour la nutrition, la nutrition médicale et les actifs pharmaceutiques.

• Appliquer la pensée analytique, l'organisation et les compétences en gestion de projet pour obtenir des résultats fiables dans un environnement de recherche complexe.

• Utiliser la programmation statistique ainsi que les normes de recherche clinique telles que le PCG de l'ICH, l'EMA, la FDA, les lignes directrices du CDISC pour appuyer la prestation d'études conformes et efficaces.

• Collaborer avec des partenaires scientifiques et commerciaux à travers une communication claire, la curiosité et un état d'esprit axé sur la qualité.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais.

• Faire place à la collaboration, à la pensée nouvelle, aux questions audacieuses, au respect et à un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être, pour créer une valeur partagée.

Chez Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons

Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and help nurture a healthier generation

As a Senior Digital and Automation Engineering Specialist (DMO/MES) at Nestlé Nutrition & Health, your mission is to identify, develop and scale digital manufacturing and automation solutions that strengthen performance across the Nutrition & Health manufacturing network. At our R&D center in Konolfingen, Switzerland, we develop science-proven nutrition products, processes and packaging, while providing technical support to Nestlé Nutrition & Health factories worldwide. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with factory, engineering, quality, operations, research and development, digital and automation teams, technology partners and strategic suppliers. This is your opportunity to grow your expertise and deliver meaningful results that help improve lives through nutrition innovation worldwide.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Digital and Automation Engineering Specialist (DMO/ MES)

• Leading the development, technical support and global deployment of digital manufacturing and automation solutions that improve reliability, efficiency and operational performance across factories.

• Driving the standardization and continuous improvement of manufacturing execution systems, operational technology and automation solutions across Nutrition and Health sites.

• Building strong partnerships with factories, project teams and technology suppliers to turn emerging digital technologies into scalable business value.

• Delivering expert guidance for investment projects, from design and commissioning to qualification, validation and handover to operations.

• Enabling secure, reliable and actionable manufacturing data through data integration and engineering initiatives that support digital transformation.

• Coaching teams and sharing best practices that strengthen digital and automation capabilities across a global manufacturing community.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in digital technologies applied to manufacturing, automation, industrial software and operational technology, supported by a Master’s degree in Engineering with a background in digital technologies.

• Applying strong experience in digital manufacturing solutions, AI and robotics, manufacturing execution systems (DMO/MES), automation and digital engineering within manufacturing or food industry environments.

• Using solid knowledge of process mastery applications, control system platforms such as Rockwell, Wonderware or AVEVA, and process simulation tools to strengthen operational performance.

• Collaborating across multidisciplinary teams to deliver engineering projects, commissioning, start-up and continuous improvement in manufacturing facilities, ideally within dairy processes.

• Communicating with full professional proficiency in English and bringing the willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 30% of the time.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

jobs.title: Proficiency Testing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As a Proficiency Testing Coordinator at Nestlé Research, your mission is to plan, coordinate, and manage internal proficiency tests from test design to final result reporting while supporting external schemes and delivering reliable insights for continuous improvement. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with R&D teams, quality experts, laboratories, factories, technology partners, and external proficiency testing providers. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Proficiency Testing Coordinator

• Coordinating internal proficiency testing schemes that help laboratories deliver reliable, comparable, and high-quality analytical results.

• Managing the full testing cycle, from scheme design and sample coordination to data evaluation, reporting, and stakeholder communication.

• Partnering with internal experts and external providers to ensure smooth delivery of standard and tailored proficiency testing programs.

• Strengthening quality and compliance by supporting accredited processes, customer feedback follow-up, and continuous improvement actions.

• Delivering consolidated reports and insights that support management decisions, stakeholder engagement, and program performance.

• Supporting digital tools and users by following up on application improvements, issue resolution, and service excellence.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a chemistry background through a CFC, bachelor’s degree, or equivalent qualification, combined with at least three years of hands-on laboratory experience.

• Applying experience or a strong interest in quality assurance, proficiency testing, and laboratory quality systems to support reliable testing outcomes.

• Using good laboratory practices, statistical methods, and accredited quality requirements to strengthen compliance and continuous improvement.

• Collaborating with a service-oriented mindset, clear communication, strong organization, and the initiative to solve problems efficiently.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

jobs.title: Automaticien.ne & Spécialiste Digital
jobs.description:
Division « Eau » du groupe Nestlé, Nestlé Waters (Suisse) SA est le leader suisse du marché des eaux minérales avec des marques telles que Henniez, S.Pellegrino, Vittel, Contrex, Perrier et Acqua Panna, ainsi que d’autres grandes marques de boissons sans alcool.

Résumé de la position

Lieu de travail: Henniez

Type de contrat: Contrat à durée indéterminée

Taux de travail: 80%-100%

En tant qu' Automaticien(ne) & Spécialiste Digital , vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le bon fonctionnement de nos installations de production et dans la digitalisation de l’usine. Véritable référent technique, vous assurerez la fiabilité des systèmes d’automation, participerez aux dépannages et contribuerez au développement des outils digitaux qui soutiennent nos opérations au quotidien.

Un jour dans la vie d’un(e) Automaticien(ne) & Spécialiste Digital

• Assurer le bon fonctionnement et la fiabilité des systèmes d’automation de l’usine.

• Diagnostiquer les pannes et participer activement aux interventions sur le terrain.

• Améliorer les programmes, équipements et systèmes afin d’optimiser la performance des lignes de production.

• Développer la maintenance préventive et contribuer à l’amélioration continue des équipements.

• Participer à l’installation, au démarrage et à la mise en service de nouveaux équipements.

• Assurer le support et le développement des outils digitaux de l’usine (MES, SAP, Power BI, Power Apps, POKA, etc.).

• Garantir la fiabilité des échanges de données entre les équipements de production, les systèmes de supervision et les applications digitales.

• Assurer le rôle d’administrateur FAS (Factory Automation System) du site.

• Maintenir à jour la documentation technique, les standards et les équipements critiques.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• CFC d’Automaticien(n), Électronicien(n) ou formation jugée équivalente avec expérience dans un environnement industriel

• Connaissances des automates Siemens et des réseaux industriels.

• Intérêt marqué pour les nouvelles technologies, l’automation et la digitalisation industrielle.

• Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques ; une expérience avec SAP, MES, Power BI, Power Apps ou POKA constitue un atout.

• Esprit d’analyse, autonomie et orientation solutions.

• Goût pour le travail de terrain et la résolution de problèmes techniques.

• Excellentes capacités de collaboration et de communication.

• Français courant ; anglais technique un atout.

jobs.title: Opérateur.trice logistique en horaires 4*8 (H/F/D)
jobs.description:
Chez Nespresso Suisse nous pensons qu’il est possible d’élever l’univers du café et nous voulons contribuer positivement à changer les vies et les paysages pour le mieux. Élu meilleur employeur 2025, nous plaçons chacun de nos 14 000 collaborateurs, sans exception, au cœur de notre réussite. Pour y parvenir, nous adoptons quatre comportements essentiels : « We Inspire, we Care, we Act, and we iNnovate ». Et vous ? Voulez-vous nous accompagner dans cette aventure passionnante ? Rejoignez l’équipe Nespresso ! Et réimaginez la nature du café. Réimaginez votre avenir.

Instantané du poste

Lieu : Romont, Switzerland

Entité : Centre de Production Nespresso
Taux : Temps plein 100%

Type de contrat : Contrat indéterminé

Ce que nous offrons chez Nespresso

De réelles opportunités d’évolution de carrière et de développement personnel

Un cadre de travail flexible facilitant la créativité et la collaboration

Une culture fondée sur la bienveillance et l’inclusivité, où chacun peut être soi-même

La qualité et la durabilité au cœur de notre identité et une vision essentielle pour favoriser le changement positif L’opportunité de travailler pour une entreprise certifiée B Corp, et l'une des marques les plus fiables et appréciées à l’échelle mondiale

Découvrez notre page Linkedin : Nespresso Centres de production

Au poste d’Opérateur.trice logistique (H/F/D), vous serez responsable de la conduite des installations de la zone logistique de production (déchetterie et distribution palette) en horaire d’équipe 4*8.

• Maîtrise des outils informatiques standards (Word, Excel, Powerpoint)

Au sein d’une équipe diverse regroupant plus de 90 nationalités dans 58 pays, vous pouvez prendre part à cette culture innovante, dans laquelle les personnes se soutiennent et s’entraident. Une culture dans laquelle chacun est encouragé à remettre en question le statu quo et à avoir un impact sur l’avenir de l’une des plus grandes entreprises durables au monde. Quel que soit le rôle que vous jouerez, vous découvrirez que vous pouvez réellement changer les choses et partager votre enthousiasme. Rejoignez ce lieu où vous pourrez vous épanouir, trouver une appartenance et l’inspiration pour devenir le meilleur de vous-même et vous surpasser.
