jobs.title: SPX Data Analytics Intern
jobs.description:
Location: Romont & occasional mobility to Vevey required, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Start date: 1 February 2027
Deadline for applications: 13 October 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As an SPX Data Analytics Intern at Nespresso , your mission will be to transform sensory and product experience data into actionable learning for coffee innovation.

You will support the collection, preparation, analysis, modelling, visualisation and documentation of large datasets while contributing to a predictive modelling project using machine learning. Working closely with the SPX Insight Specialist, SPX Data Specialist and partners across R&D, Marketing, Consumer & Market Intelligence, E-commerce and IT, you will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of data science, consumer insights and coffee innovation.

How you’ll make an impact as an SPX Data Analytics Intern

• Prepare, analyse, model sensory and product experience (SPX) data in order to develop a predictive model using machine learning to generate clear and useful insights

• Support KPI reporting and create effective dashboards and visualisations using tools such as Power BI or KNIME

• Perform data-quality checks and help improve the efficiency, reproducibility and traceability of data-management activities

• Contribute to the testing and continuous improvement of data tools while documenting your methods, findings and recommendations

• Collaborate with technical and non-technical partners and present your findings clearly to the SPX team and broader R&D stakeholders

What will make you successful

• Currently completing a Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, Consumer Science, Sensory Science or a related field

• Data science and coding skills, with practical knowledge of Python or R. Experience (work or academic) with Snowflake, Power BI, KNIME or similar tools and platforms is an advantage

• Hands-on experience preparing, analysing, modelling and visualising datasets through academic or practical projects

• Ability to interpret data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Curious, analytical and detail-oriented, with a proactive and solution-focused approach

• Fluent in English. French or another language is an advantage

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value

At Nespresso, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Romont & mobilità occasionale a Vevey richiesto, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: Hybrid
Tipo di contratto / durata: Stage – 6 mesi
Data di inizio: 1 febbraio 2027
Termine ultimo per le domande: 13 ottobre 2026

Essere una forza per il bene e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario

Come Interno SPX Data Analytics presso Nespresso®, la vostra missione sarà quella di trasformare i dati sensoriali e di esperienza dei prodotti in apprendimento attuabile per l'innovazione del caffè.

Supporterai la raccolta, la preparazione, l'analisi, la modellazione, la visualizzazione e la documentazione di grandi set di dati, contribuendo a un progetto di modellazione predittiva utilizzando l'apprendimento automatico. Lavorando a stretto contatto con il SPX Insight Specialist, SPX Data Specialist e partner in R&D, Marketing, Consumer & Market Intelligence, E-commerce e IT, si acquisirà esperienza pratica all'intersezione di scienza dei dati, intuizioni dei consumatori e innovazione del caffè.

Come farete un impatto come Interno SPX Data Analytics

• Preparare, analizzare, modellare i dati sensoriali e di prodotto (SPX) per sviluppare un modello predittivo utilizzando l'apprendimento automatico per generare intuizioni chiare e utili

• Supporta il reporting KPI e crea dashboard e visualizzazioni efficaci utilizzando strumenti come Power BI o KNIME

• Eseguire controlli di qualità dei dati e contribuire a migliorare l'efficienza, la riproducibilità e la tracciabilità delle attività di gestione dei dati

• Contribuisci al test e al miglioramento continuo degli strumenti di dati documentando i tuoi metodi, risultati e raccomandazioni

• Collabora con partner tecnici e non tecnici e presenta chiaramente i tuoi risultati al team SPX e agli stakeholder R&D più ampi

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Attualmente completando un Master in Scienza dei dati, Statistica, Scienza informatica, Business Analytics, Ingegneria, Scienza dei consumatori, Scienza sensoriale o un campo relativo

• Scienza dei dati e competenze di codifica, con conoscenze pratiche di Python o R. Experience (lavoro o accademico) con Snowflake, Power BI, KNIME o strumenti e piattaforme simili è un vantaggio

• Hands-on esperienza preparazione, analisi, modellazione e visualizzazione di dataset attraverso progetti accademici o pratici

• Capacità di interpretare i dati e comunicare i risultati con chiarezza sia al pubblico tecnico che non tecnico

• Curioso, analitico e dettagliato, con un approccio proattivo e orientato alla soluzione

• Fluente in inglese. Francese o un'altra lingua è un vantaggio

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile e creando valore condiviso

A Nespresso, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto per iniziare il tuo viaggio di carriera con noi?

Applicare ora e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario.

Startdatum: 1. Februar 2027
Bewerbungsfrist: 13. Oktober 2026

Seien Sie eine Kraft für das Gute und verwandeln Sie Ihr Potenzial in etwas Außergewöhnliches

Als SPX Data Analytics Praktikant bei Nespresso besteht Ihre Mission darin, sensorische und Produkterfahrungsdaten in umsetzbares Lernen für Kaffeeinnovationen zu verwandeln.

Sie unterstützen die Sammlung, Vorbereitung, Analyse, Modellierung, Visualisierung und Dokumentation großer Datensätze und tragen gleichzeitig zu einem prädiktiven Modellierungsprojekt mit maschinellem Lernen bei. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem SPX Insight Specialist, SPX Data Specialist und Partnern aus den Bereichen R&D, Marketing, Consumer & Market Intelligence, E-Commerce und IT erhalten Sie praktische Erfahrungen an der Schnittstelle von Data Science, Consumer Insights und Kaffeeinnovation.

Wie Sie als SPX Data Analytics Intern etwas bewirken können

• Bereiten, analysieren, modellieren sensorische und Produkterfahrung (SPX) Daten, um ein prädiktives Modell mit maschinellem Lernen zu entwickeln, um klare und nützliche Erkenntnisse zu generieren

• Unterstützen Sie das KPI-Reporting und erstellen Sie effektive Dashboards und Visualisierungen mit Tools wie Power BI oder KNIME

• Durchführung von Datenqualitätsprüfungen und Beitrag zur Verbesserung der Effizienz, Reproduzierbarkeit und Rückverfolgbarkeit von Datenmanagementaktivitäten

• Tragen Sie zum Testen und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Datentools bei und dokumentieren Sie Ihre Methoden, Erkenntnisse und Empfehlungen

• Arbeiten Sie mit technischen und nicht-technischen Partnern zusammen und präsentieren Sie Ihre Ergebnisse dem SPX-Team und breiteren F & E-Stakeholdern.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Derzeit Abschluss eines Master-Abschlusses in Data Science, Statistik, Informatik, Business Analytics, Engineering, Consumer Science, Sensory Science oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Data Science und Programmierkenntnisse, mit praktischen Kenntnissen von Python oder R. Erfahrung (Arbeit oder akademische) mit Snowflake, Power BI, KNIME oder ähnlichen Tools und Plattformen ist ein Vorteil

• Praktische Erfahrung bei der Vorbereitung, Analyse, Modellierung und Visualisierung von Datensätzen durch akademische oder praktische Projekte

• Fähigkeit, Daten zu interpretieren und Erkenntnisse sowohl für technische als auch für nicht-technische Zielgruppen klar zu kommunizieren

• Neugierig, analytisch und detailorientiert, mit proaktivem und lösungsorientiertem Ansatz

• fließend in Englisch. Französisch oder eine andere Sprache ist von Vorteil

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen

Bei Nespresso stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für bürobasierte Rollen)

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird die Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Karriere mit uns zu beginnen?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und verwandeln Sie Ihr Potenzial in etwas Außergewöhnliches.

• Capacité d'interpréter les données et de communiquer clairement les résultats aux publics techniques et non techniques

• Curieux, analytique et axé sur les détails, avec une approche proactive et axée sur les solutions

• En anglais. Le français ou une autre langue est un avantage

jobs.title: Head of GBS Finance
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Act. Rate: Full-Time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent contract

Start date: February 2027

Deadline for applications: 25 September 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As the Head of Global Business Services Finance at Nestlé, your mission is to act as a key finance partner to the Head of GBS and the GBS Management Team. You will shape the financial roadmap, challenge business decisions, and ensure disciplined planning, performance management, cost transparency and value realization across the global GBS network. Working closely with Center Heads, End-to-End solution leads, Global Process Owners, Markets, IT & Digital, and external partners, you will provide forward-looking insights, enable fact-based decisions, and strengthen accountability for financial outcomes. You will lead an international finance team in different locations and help GBS deliver sustainable efficiency, effectiveness, and business value.

How you’ll make an impact as a Head of GBS Finance

• Bring deep expertise in the operational financial management of Global Business Services, using cost, efficiency, quality and service-performance insights to improve both efficiency and effectiveness.

• While leveraging AI tools, develop and maintain unit-cost, productivity and service-performance measures that connect financial outcomes with operational volumes, quality and service levels. Use internal and external benchmarks to identify improvement opportunities.

• Planning, coordinating and maintaining cost control of our Business Centers operations, measuring performance against plan and proposing necessary action plans to achieve targets in a context of important transition plan.

• Ensure challenging stretched targets are set for each Shared Service Center, end-to-end solution lead and Management Services unit, and tracking performance in a timely manner.

• Establish and govern a consistent framework to validate, track and report productivity, transformation benefits and value delivery, including agreed baselines, ownership, timing and reconciliation to reported financial results.

• Ensure a robust, documented and transparent billing and reconciliation process across the GBS network, including accurate and timely charges to internal customers, clear allocation drivers, dispute resolution and compliance with applicable transfer-pricing and accounting requirements.

• Own and continuously improve a transparent, driver-based costing and charging model for GBS services. Define financial evaluation and performance-tracking methodologies, assess business cases and contract changes, and ensure continuity plans reflect current financial exposures and operational requirements.

• Lead financial and commercial governance of external service providers, including contract economics, rate cards, indexation, volume commitments, service credits, change requests, invoice validation and value-for-money assessments.

• Lead, develop and inspire your team in an international environment while working collaboratively and cross functionally with IT & Digital, Global Process Owners and Markets.

What will make you successful

• Demonstrating senior finance leadership experience in GBS operational financial models and in complex global organizations, supported by relevant finance, accounting or business qualification.

• Applying financial analysis and co-piloting experience to various senior stakeholders through a strong command of management accounting, planning and forecasting, service costing, investment appraisal, financial controls and commercial contract management.

• Developing and improving financial systems and major business processes, with exposure to audit, project financial evaluation and contract reviews.

• Strong focus on compliance, rock solid reporting and internal controls.

• Managing and developing people, including virtual teams, with good organizational and planning skills.

• Communicating fluently in English, with superior written and verbal communication skills to effectively address and influence all levels, leadership team and internal customers.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Performance based bonus

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to a fair and transparent hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition, and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Permanent contract

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Corporate Insurance Specialist – Non-Life & Insured Benefits at Nestlé, your mission is to support the effective renewal and administration of global insurance programs that protect our people, operations and assets. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with Group Risk Services colleagues, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, markets, insurance brokers and insurers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Corporate Insurance Specialist – Non-Life & Insured Benefits

• Supporting timely, accurate renewals of global non-life and insured employee benefits programs.

• Coordinating insurance data, submissions and documentation to strengthen coverage decisions across markets.

• Ensuring policies, endorsements, premium allocations and payments are accurate and completed on time.

• Managing smaller insurance programs from renewal administration through payment and claims follow-up.

• Contributing to fair, effective selection processes for global and local insurers and brokers.

• Building trusted relationships that improve service quality and support consistent insurance delivery worldwide.

What will make you successful

• Bringing practical knowledge of insurance gained with an insurer, broker or corporate risk management team.

• Applying strong attention to detail across renewals, data collection, policy reviews, premium allocation and record keeping.

• Using sound knowledge of non-life insurance and insured employee benefits to support global programs confidently.

• Collaborating effectively across teams while building productive relationships with insurers, brokers and internal partners.

• Communicating fluently in English; French and German are an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

jobs.title: Digital Process Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Digital Process Design Engineer at Nestlé Product & Technology Center Nutrition & Health, your mission is to develop, standardize and govern process engineering drawings and digital plant models that enable safe, efficient and reusable solutions for nutrition industrialization projects. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with process and automation engineers, project managers, factory teams and equipment suppliers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Digital Process Design Engineer

• Developing accurate process diagrams, equipment layouts and three-dimensional plant models that turn engineering concepts into implementation-ready designs.

• Standardizing modular design components, drawing libraries and templates to improve quality, consistency and reuse across global projects.

• Reviewing supplier drawings and digital models to identify clashes and strengthen safety, hygiene, operability, maintainability and accessibility.

• Delivering basic engineering solutions for defined process units, including layouts, equipment interfaces, utility needs and technical specifications.

• Managing engineering data and synchronized digital plant information so teams can find, trust and use current documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

• Driving continuous improvement in design workflows and standards while sharing practical drafting knowledge with engineers, factories and suppliers.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong two-dimensional and three-dimensional drafting capability for process plants, equipment layouts and engineering documentation.

• Applying computer-aided design tools, ideally including AutoCAD, Plant 3D and Inventor, to create precise and reusable design solutions.

• Using knowledge of process equipment, piping, utilities, instrumentation and hygienic design to strengthen safe and practical layouts.

• Collaborating proactively with engineers, factory partners and suppliers while managing engineering data, revisions and document standards with care.

• Communicating confidently in English at a good working level.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

jobs.title: Nutrition Digital Capabilities Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne , Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As a Nutrition Digital Capabilities Specialist at Société des Produits Nestlé SA, your mission is to turn nutrition data into reliable insights, digital prototypes and reporting capabilities that support Nestlé’s Nutrition, Health and Wellness (NHW) strategy and strengthen the nutritional value of our product portfolio. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with the NHW, Research and Development, IT teams. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Nutrition Digital Capabilities Specialist

• Leading nutrition data analysis to support portfolio decisions.

• Building automated dashboards and reporting capabilities that improve accuracy, efficiency and visibility across global nutrition data.

• Driving data quality, validation and audit readiness to strengthen confidence in internal and external nutrition reporting.

• Developing digital prototypes and new automated functionalities that make nutrition reporting and benchmarking faster, smarter and easier to use.

• Delivering data-driven knowledge projects with clear plans, strong governance and high-quality scientific outputs.

• Nurturing cross-functional networks to understand business needs, share ideas and build digital nutrition capabilities at scale.

What will make you successful

• Master's degree in a relevant field such as data science, statistics, nutrition, food science or equivalent.

• Bringing strong data analytics skills, ideally applied to nutrition, food data or scientific reporting.

• Proven previous experience, preferably in a food manufacturing or recipe management environment.

• Applying knowledge of recipe management, food regulations, nutrition labelling and data governance to create reliable outputs.

• Using data analysis, visualisation, database querying or programming tools to translate complex data into clear insights.

• Collaborating across functions, influencing with integrity and managing projects to deliver meaningful outcomes.

• Communicating with working proficiency in English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. • Le prestazioni del sistema di guida per offrire una qualità coppe costante e un'eccellente esperienza utente nei sistemi di bevande.

• Costruire la comprensione scientifica delle interazioni tra macchine, prodotti e imballaggi per ottimizzare le decisioni di progettazione.

• Fahrsystemleistung, um eine gleichbleibende Tassenqualität und eine hervorragende Benutzererfahrung in allen Getränkesystemen zu bieten.

• Aufbau eines wissenschaftsbasierten Verständnisses der Interaktionen von Maschinen, Produkten und Verpackungen zur Optimierung von Designentscheidungen.

• Einbringen von fundiertem Wissen über Physik, Strömungsmechanik und Leistung von Getränkesystemen zur Lösung komplexer technischer Herausforderungen.

• Anwendung einer wissenschaftsbasierten Denkweise, um Interaktionen zwischen Maschine, Produkt und Verpackung zu verstehen.

Sei eine Kraft für das Gute und beschleunige Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern

Als Manager für interne Kommunikation bei Nestlé ist es Ihre Mission, globale interne Kommunikationsprioritäten zu gestalten und sie in klare Pläne, koordinierte Maßnahmen und messbare Auswirkungen umzuwandeln. Wie Sie als Manager für interne Kommunikation etwas bewirken können

• Gestaltung globaler interner Kommunikationsprioritäten in klaren Zielen und koordinierten Umsetzungsplänen.

• Verknüpfung von Kampagnen, Führungskommunikation, Kanälen, Veranstaltungen und Engagement zu einer kohärenten globalen Agenda.

• Kühne redaktionelle Ausrichtung und Umsetzung komplexer Prioritäten in klare, überzeugende Geschichten.

• Führende prioritäre Initiativen von Strategie und Konzept bis hin zu Aktivierung, Engagement und Evaluierung.

• Ausrichtung der Stakeholder in der gesamten Organisation, um wichtige Unternehmensmomente zu stärken und eine effektive Umsetzung zu gewährleisten.

• Nutzung von Audience Insight, Leistungsdaten und Feedback zur Verbesserung von Kommunikationsentscheidungen und messbaren Auswirkungen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der strategischen internen Kommunikation, Unternehmensangelegenheiten oder Marketing, um Geschäftsprioritäten mit den Bedürfnissen des Publikums zu verbinden.

• Ein starkes redaktionelles Urteilsvermögen, um komplexe Themen zu vereinfachen und klare, ansprechende Narrative zu erstellen.

• Einbringen von Know-how in strukturierter Planung, Audience Insight und Performance-Daten, um schnell zu liefern und Ergebnisse zu verbessern.

• Collaborer entre les équipes et influencer les collègues et les partenaires afin d'harmoniser les priorités et d'élargir les pratiques efficaces.

jobs.title: Senior Technician
jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Senior Technician in Micronutrients and Phytochemicals Analytics at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide high-quality analytical support that helps research and operations teams make confident, science-based decisions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, analytical experts, technical teams and partners across Nestlé Research. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Technician in Micronutrients and Phytochemicals Analytics

• Delivering reliable analytical data that supports research, product quality and operational decisions.

• Developing and applying sample preparation methods within projects, including approaches for allergens, microparticles, micronutrients and phytochemicals analysis as well as spectroscopic measurements.

• Operating and maintaining advanced analytical equipment to ensure robust, timely and high-quality results.

• Evaluating analytical outcomes critically and turning results into clear insights for project teams and stakeholders.

• Contributing to method development and providing technical assistance to markets, including analytical support for allergen-related topics where the role may require handling or being in direct contact with allergenic food materials.

• Supporting project teams with technical assistance, sample preparation for trace analysis and analytical interpretation to ensure robust delivery of project objectives.

• Sharing expertise with colleagues, apprentices and students to build capability across analytical activities.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a Bachelor’s degree, CFC or equivalent qualification in analytical chemistry or a related field, with solid experience in sample preparation gained in industry or academia.

• Applying hands-on knowledge of allergen analysis and being comfortable working in a laboratory environment where allergenic food materials may be handled, prepared or analyzed, with potential direct contact as part of the role. You will also bring knowledge of spectroscopic measurements such as infrared, Raman or X-ray fluorescence, ideally including microparticle analysis. Knowledge in trace analysis and liquid chromatography is a plus.

• Using good laboratory practices, quality and safety standards to deliver accurate, compliant and trusted results.

• Collaborating with curiosity, analytical rigor and a solution-oriented mindset in diverse technical teams.

• Communicating confidently in English and French.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

jobs.title: Global Procurement Manager - Machines
jobs.description:
Location: La Tour-de-Peilz, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Temporary – Maternity cover

Ideal starting date: ASAP

Be a force for good and feel trusted to make decisions that matter.

As a Global Procurement Manager for Machines at Nestlé Global Procurement, your mission is to lead and implement the global sourcing strategy for Nespresso Original Line and Milk frother, delivering value through innovation, competitiveness, sustainability, and risk management. You are responsible for end-to-end spend management, supplier selection, negotiations and managing relationships with coffee machine manufacturers to ensure a reliable, high-quality, and cost-effective supply chain aligned with Nestlé’s Procurement Standards. We operate on a truly global scale, bringing together over 40 nationalities across three dynamic hubs in Switzerland, Panama, and Malaysia. This is your chance to drive innovation, sustainability, and impact at scale, ensuring value creation through responsibly sourced supply across diverse categories.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Procurement Manager – Machines

• Define and implement the sourcing strategy for Nespresso Original Line and Milk frother, aligned with the Global Beverage Machine category while contributing to its development.

• Lead sourcing activities for supplier selection, leveraging negotiations, eRFX solutions, and by executing best‑in‑class Manufacturing and Supply Agreements.

• Build and lead the efficiency roadmap by driving cost‑reduction initiatives such as component standardization through platform approaches, best‑cost‑country sourcing and the use of alternative materials.

• Strengthen sourcing flexibility and supply risk mitigation across the full value chain, from Machine assembly to components and their raw materials.

• Build strong relationships with Nespresso Procurement business partners to unlock full category‑management value.

• Lead supplier development and compliance, including performance assessment and supplier profiling with clear targets and development plans.

• Develop and analyze TDC (Total Delivered Cost), monitor commodity trends and manage budget variations through proactive price anticipation and productivity impact.

What will make you successful

• Solid experience and proven proficiency in procurement within above‑market or large‑market structures, ideally in Contract Manufacturing procurement or technical categories.

• Dual competence supported by a degree in mechanical or electronic engineering (preferred).

• Advanced negotiation capabilities, with proven experience in eRFX and high‑value contract management.

• Strong analytical skills and Total Delivered Cost mindset, with the ability to manage multiple sub‑categories simultaneously (electronics, electro‑mechanical, plastic injection, CAPEX).

• Excellent communication abilities, enabling clear presentation of opportunities, results, and actionable recommendations.

• Fluent written and spoken English, any additional language considered as a strong plus.

Be a force for good and feel trusted to make decisions that matter.

As a Global Procurement Manager for Machines at Nestlé Global Procurement, your mission is to lead and implement the global sourcing strategy for Nespresso Original Line and Milk frother, delivering value through innovation, competitiveness, sustainability, and risk management. You are responsible for end-to-end spend management, supplier selection, negotiations and managing relationships with coffee machine manufacturers to ensure a reliable, high-quality, and cost-effective supply chain aligned with Nestlé’s Procurement Standards. We operate on a truly global scale, bringing together over 40 nationalities across three dynamic hubs in Switzerland, Panama, and Malaysia. This is your chance to drive innovation, sustainability, and impact at scale, ensuring value creation through responsibly sourced supply across diverse categories.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Procurement Manager – Machines

• Define and implement the sourcing strategy for Nespresso Original Line and Milk frother, aligned with the Global Beverage Machine category while contributing to its development.

• Lead sourcing activities for supplier selection, leveraging negotiations, eRFX solutions, and by executing best‑in‑class Manufacturing and Supply Agreements.

• Build and lead the efficiency roadmap by driving cost‑reduction initiatives such as component standardization through platform approaches, best‑cost‑country sourcing and the use of alternative materials.

• Strengthen sourcing flexibility and supply risk mitigation across the full value chain, from Machine assembly to components and their raw materials.

• Build strong relationships with Nespresso Procurement business partners to unlock full category‑management value.

• Lead supplier development and compliance, including performance assessment and supplier profiling with clear targets and development plans.

• Develop and analyze TDC (Total Delivered Cost), monitor commodity trends and manage budget variations through proactive price anticipation and productivity impact.

What will make you successful

• Solid experience and proven proficiency in procurement within above‑market or large‑market structures, ideally in Contract Manufacturing procurement or technical categories.

• Dual competence supported by a degree in mechanical or electronic engineering (preferred).

• Advanced negotiation capabilities, with proven experience in eRFX and high‑value contract management.

• Strong analytical skills and Total Delivered Cost mindset, with the ability to manage multiple sub‑categories simultaneously (electronics, electro‑mechanical, plastic injection, CAPEX).

• Excellent communication abilities, enabling clear presentation of opportunities, results, and actionable recommendations.

• Fluent written and spoken English, any additional language considered as a strong plus.

At Nestlé Global Procurement, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and feel trusted to make decisions that matter.

• Utilizzando le capacità di coaching e influenzando le capacità di coinvolgere, sviluppare e supportare diverse squadre.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Standort: Vevey, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort / Vollzeit
Vertragsart: Permanent

Reiserate: 100% (rund 90% fabrikbasiert und 10% HQ-basiert)

Programm: 4-jähriges Entwicklungsprogramm mit 5-6-monatigen internationalen Werkseinsätzen im globalen Operations-Netzwerk von Nestlé

Sei eine Kraft für das Gute und beschleunige Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern

Als Senior Analyst für Performance Acceleration bei Nestlé Operations nehmen Sie an einem einzigartigen 4-jährigen Entwicklungsprogramm teil, das internationale Aufträge von 5-6 Monaten in Nestlé-Fabriken auf der ganzen Welt abschließt. Ihre Mission wird es sein, die operative Leistung zu beschleunigen und nachhaltige Verbesserungen in unserem globalen Produktionsnetzwerk voranzutreiben. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit lokalen Fabrikteams, F & E-Experten und Unternehmensbeteiligten zusammenarbeiten.

Mit umfangreichen internationalen Reisen und einem praktischen Kontakt zu komplexen Fertigungsbetrieben haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre Karriere auszubauen, in verschiedenen Kulturen und Produktionsumgebungen zu arbeiten und ein starkes Netzwerk innerhalb der globalen Operations-Community von Nestlé aufzubauen.

Wie Sie als Performance Acceleration Senior Analyst etwas bewirken können

• Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen, die Leistung, Produktivität und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit in allen Fabriken weltweit verbessern.

• Leitende operative Optimierungs- und digitale Transformationsprojekte, die messbare und nachhaltige Ergebnisse liefern.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Fabrikführungsteams, technischen Experten und globalen Stakeholdern, um die Umsetzung und Wertschöpfung zu beschleunigen.

• Coaching-Teams und Unterstützung beim Aufbau von Fähigkeiten, um Best Practices einzubetten und langfristige Verbesserungen zu unterstützen.

• Verwaltung funktionsübergreifender Projekte und Nutzung des globalen Netzwerks von Nestlé, um Wissen zu teilen, Leistung zu vergleichen und Innovationen zu beschleunigen.

• Stärkung der operativen Exzellenzfähigkeiten durch Förderung von Fertigungsstandards und kontinuierlichem Lernen auf allen Märkten.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bringen Sie Erfahrung in einer Fabrikumgebung, wie Produktion, Qualität, Engineering oder verwandte Fertigungsfunktionen. Frühere Linienmanagement-Erfahrung ist ein Plus.

• Anwendung einer starken Projektführung und Problemlösungskompetenz, um sinnvolle Geschäftsverbesserungen zu erzielen.

• Einsatz von Coaching- und Einflussmöglichkeiten, um verschiedene Teams zu engagieren, zu entwickeln und zu unterstützen.

• Eine sehr internationale Rolle, die umfangreiche Reisen, langfristige Werksaufträge und die Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams in verschiedenen Kulturen und Märkten kombiniert.

• Fließend Englisch kommunizieren; zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen.

Bei Nestlé stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun.

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Videointerview mit Talent Acquisition, eine Bewertung, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit, eine Kraft für das Gute zu sein?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und beschleunigen Sie den Wandel, der das Leben und den Planeten verbessert.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: Vevey, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Sur place / Temps plein
Type de contrat : Permanent

Taux de déplacement : 100 % (environ 90 % en usine et 10 % en QG)

Programme: programme de développement de 4 ans avec des missions internationales d'usine de 5 à 6 mois dans l'ensemble du réseau mondial d'opérations de Nestlé

Être une force pour le bien et accélérer le changement qui améliore les vies et la planète

En tant qu'analyste principal de l'accélération de la performance à Nestlé Operations, vous vous joignez à un programme de développement unique de 4 ans. Votre mission sera d'accélérer les performances opérationnelles et de favoriser des améliorations durables dans notre réseau mondial de fabrication. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes d'usines locales, les experts en R-D et les intervenants de l'entreprise.

Avec des voyages internationaux étendus et une exposition pratique à des opérations de fabrication complexes, c'est l'occasion de développer votre carrière, de travailler dans des cultures et des environnements de production variés et de bâtir un solide réseau au sein de la communauté des Opérations mondiales de Nestlé.

Comment vous aurez un impact en tant qu'analyste principal de l'accélération du rendement

• Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue qui améliorent la performance, la productivité et la compétitivité dans les usines du monde entier.

• Diriger des projets d'optimisation opérationnelle et de transformation numérique qui produisent des résultats mesurables et durables.

• Collaborer avec les équipes de direction de l'usine, les experts techniques et les intervenants mondiaux pour accélérer la mise en œuvre et la création de valeur.

• Encadrer les équipes et appuyer le renforcement des capacités pour intégrer les pratiques exemplaires et soutenir les améliorations à long terme.

• Gérer des projets interfonctionnels tout en tirant parti du réseau mondial de Nestlé pour partager les connaissances, évaluer les performances et accélérer l'innovation.

• Renforcer les capacités d'excellence opérationnelle en favorisant les normes de fabrication et l'apprentissage continu dans tous les marchés.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter de l'expérience dans un environnement industriel, comme la production, la qualité, l'ingénierie ou les fonctions de fabrication connexes. L'expérience précédente en gestion de ligne est un plus.

• Appliquer de solides compétences en leadership de projet et en résolution de problèmes pour améliorer de façon significative les activités.

• Utiliser le coaching et influencer les capacités pour engager, développer et soutenir diverses équipes.

• Faire place à un rôle hautement international qui combine des voyages étendus, des missions d'usine à long terme et une collaboration avec diverses équipes de cultures et de marchés différents.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais; des compétences linguistiques supplémentaires sont un avantage.

• Démontrer courage, collaboration, rapidité et apprentissage continu.

Chez Nestlé, on place les gens au cœur de tout ce qu'on fait.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime fondée sur les performances

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte contribution de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue vidéo avec Talent Acquisition, une évaluation, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de façon confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses électroniques officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à n'importe quelle étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à être une force pour le bien?

Appliquer maintenant et accélérer le changement qui améliore les vies et la planète.

jobs.title: Associate Specialist Lipids
jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Full time
Contract type / duration: 2 years limited contract

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As an Associate Specialist Lipids at Nestlé Research, your mission is to strengthen scientific expertise and generate new insights in lipid physics and chemistry for food applications. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with multidisciplinary research teams, product development teams, expert networks, innovation partners, suppliers, universities, and research institutes. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist Lipids

• Building scientific knowledge of emerging methods, trends, and discoveries in lipid science and technology.

• Developing robust scientific concepts that translate lipid research into food applications and consumer benefits.

• Leading research projects and communicating scientific approaches and results to technical and business audiences.

• Designing and executing laboratory studies that advance understanding of lipid crystallisation, structuring, and oxidation.

• Transferring scientific knowledge to development teams to accelerate innovation projects and successful product launches.

• Strengthening scientific visibility through intellectual property, publications, conference presentations, and coaching of students and technicians.

What will make you successful

• Holding a PhD in Food Science/Chemistry, Food Engineering, or a related area, with strong knowledge of lipid science, including lipid crystallisation, structuring, and oxidation.

• Applying analytical thinking and problem-solving to turn science and technology into consumer and business value.

• Using project management, organisation, and communication skills to deliver clear scientific outcomes.

• Collaborating proactively across disciplines while showing initiative, integrity, and a passion for knowledge sharing.

• Communicating fluently in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

jobs.title: Anlagenführer/-in Special Products (probiotische Produkte)
jobs.description:
Übersicht Position

Standort: Konolfingen, Schweiz
Unternehmen: Nestlé Schweiz S.A.
Beschäftigungsgrad: 100%
Vertragsart: unbefristet
Anstellungsbeginn: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Benefits

• Internationales Arbeitsumfeld

• Durchschnittlich 41-Stunden-Woche, je nach Schichtplan

• Min. 25 Tage Ferien pro Jahr, je nach Alter mehr

• 18 Wochen bezahlter Mutterschaftsurlaub, 4 Wochen bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub

• 13. Monatslohn und Bonusmöglichkeit

• Leistungen der Pensionskasse über dem gesetzlichen Minimum

• Beiträge an die Krankentaggeldversicherung zu 100% vom Arbeitgeber bezahlt

• Schichtpauschale sowie Schichtzulagen über den gesetzlichen Vorgaben

• Kostenfreies Schichtessen

• Kostenfreier Parkplatz

• Rabatt im Nestlé Shop (vor Ort in Konolfingen)

• Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio in Konolfingen zu Sonderkonditionen

• Viele Möglichkeiten zur Karriereentwicklung und persönlichen Entfaltung

Kurzüberblick Position

550 Mitarbeitende, die für die Herstellung hochwertiger Säuglingsnahrung für das In- und Ausland zuständig sind, prägen das dynamische, hochautomatisierte Arbeitsumfeld der Fabrik Konolfingen. Dies stellt täglich hohe Ansprüche an unser Team in Bezug auf Einhaltung von Hygienebestimmungen und Arbeitssicherheit. Möchten auch Sie Teil unseres Teams sein?

Zur Verstärkung unserer Abteilung Special Products (SP) suchen wir eine kommunikative und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit als Anlagenführer/-in.

Ein Tag im Leben eines/-r Anlagenführer/-in

• Aufbereitung von Milch und Kindernahrungsmitteln mit Hilfe moderner Produktionsanlagen

• Durchführung der Rohstoffaufgabe, Sprühtrocknung sowie Mischen, Bereitstellung und Abfüllung von Pulver

• Durchführung des Reinigungsprozesses (CIP-Reinigungen) sowie allgemeine Reinigungsarbeiten gemäss den bestehenden Qualitätsvorgaben

• Dokumentation der Produktions- und Reinigungsabläufe

• Tätigkeiten im Linienlabor und Durchführung von Analysen gemäss QMS

• Verantwortlichkeit für die Produktherstellung unter Einhaltung der Sicherheits-, Hygiene- und Umweltvorschriften sowie nach NGMP und SOP's

• Sicherstellung eines schonenden Umganges mit Roh- und Packstoffen sowie Energien, Anlagen, Laborgeräten und Reinigungsmitteln

• Bereitschaft zur Schicht- und Wochenendarbeit

Das macht Sie erfolgreich

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene EFZ-Ausbildung als Milchtechnologe oder Lebensmitteltechnologe oder langjährige Erfahrung als Anlagenführer/-in im Lebensmittelbereich

• Gutes technisches Verständnis und ein proaktives Handeln

• Kundenorientiertes Verhalten in allen Arbeitssituationen

• Ausgeprägtes Sicherheits-, Umwelt- und Hygienebewusstsein

• Teamfähige und selbstständige Persönlichkeit, die Eigeninitiative und Engagement zeigt

• Geübter Umgang in SAP, MES und MS Office

• Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutschkenntnisse

Wir bei Nestlé wollen dazu beitragen, eine bessere und gesündere Welt zu gestalten, Menschen zu einem gesünderen Leben zu inspirieren und in einem Umfang und Tempo zu arbeiten, das einen Unterschied machte. Wir tun dies, indem wir ein vielfältiges, freundliches, unterstützendes und kollaboratives Umfeld fördern, das positiven Wandel hervorruft, Innovationen begrüsst und Menschen und Teams befähigt, zu gewinnen.

Sie möchten für die ganz Kleinen auf dieser Welt Grosses bewirken? Werden Sie Teil von Nestlé und senden uns Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Diplome etc.) direkt online zu.

550 dipendenti, responsabili della produzione di alimenti per bambini di alta qualità per la Germania e l'estero, plasmano l'ambiente di lavoro dinamico e altamente automatizzato della fabbrica di Konolfingen. • Personalità di squadra e indipendente che mostra iniziativa e impegno

• Molto buona conoscenza orale e scritta del tedesco

Benefits

• Free shift eating

• Free parking

• Many opportunities for career development and personal development

Short overview position

550 employees, who are responsible for the production of high-quality infant food for Germany and abroad, shape the dynamic, highly automated working environment of the Konolfingen factory. This places high demands on our team every day in terms of compliance with hygiene regulations and occupational safety. Would you also like to be part of our team?

To strengthen our Special Products (SP) department, we are looking for a communicative and responsible personality as a plant manager.

A day in the life of a plant manager

• Processing of milk and children’s foods with the help of modern production facilities

• Implementation of the feed of raw materials, spray drying and mixing, provision and filling of powder

• Implementation of the cleaning process (CIP cleaning) as well as general cleaning work according to the existing quality specifications

• Documentation of production and cleaning processes

• Activities in the line laboratory and carrying out analyses according to QMS

• Responsibility for product manufacturing in compliance with safety, hygiene and environmental regulations as well as NGMP and SOP's

• Ensuring careful handling of raw and packaging materials as well as energies, plants, laboratory equipment and cleaning agents

• Readiness for shift and weekend work

This makes them successful.

• Successfully completed EFZ training as a dairy technologist or food technologist or many years of experience as a plant manager in the food sector

• Good technical understanding and proactive action

• Customer-oriented behavior in all work situations

• Strong safety, environmental and hygiene awareness

• Team-capable and independent personality who shows initiative and commitment

• Practical handling in SAP, MES and MS Office

• Very good oral and written knowledge of German

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives, and work at a scale and pace that made a difference. We do this by fostering a diverse, friendly, supportive and collaborative environment that inspires positive change, welcomes innovation and empowers people and teams to win.

Do you want to do great things for the very little ones in this world? Become part of Nestlé and send us your complete application documents (motivation letter, CV, certificates, diplomas, etc.) directly online.

jobs.title: SPX Data Specialist / Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Romont, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

As a SPX Data Specialist / Data Engineer at Nespresso , your mission is to turn sensory, consumer, product and market data into trusted insights that strengthen coffee superiority, coffee authority and consumer centricity. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with Sensory and Product Experience, Product Development Center, Coffee Expertise, Innovation, Marketing, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, NPTC Coffee, and information technology and data teams. This is your opportunity to elevate the world of coffee through meaningful results that drive positive impact.

How you’ll make an impact as a SPX Data Specialist / Data Engineer

• Leading data flows across sensory, consumer, product, technical, market and operational sources to enable trusted and faster decision-making.

• Building strong data foundations that improve quality, accessibility and governance for strategic coffee projects.

• Embedding scalable analytics into innovation and renovation governance so teams can identify risks earlier and make stronger portfolio choices.

• Developing reusable models, dashboards and decision tools that increase insight speed, traceability and self-service.

• Partnering with data and technology teams to create reliable systems, pipelines and digital solutions for product development.

• Growing analytical capability across teams through training, coaching and practical ways of working that support a data-driven culture.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in data analysis, modelling and business intelligence to turn complex information into actionable recommendations.

• Applying knowledge of data governance, data quality and decision-support methodologies to build trusted and scalable insight solutions.

• Solid experience within Power BI, Python, Azure, Power Query, VBA or R Shiny to automate analysis, reporting and digital workflows.

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to influence priorities, align methods and drive adoption of data-driven practices.

• Communicating fluently in English and French.

• Embodying our WECAN behaviors: We Inspire, we Care, we Act, and we Innovate, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to grow together?

Apply now and reimagine what you can become.

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

At Nestlé, our purpose is to unlock the power of food and beverages to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come.

As Global Marketing Lead Inflammatory Bowel Diseases & Modulen® Brand Lead at Nestlé Nutrition & Health , your mission is to develop and lead the global strategy that will help Nestlé win in Inflammatory Bowel Diseases, while providing global brand leadership for Modulen®. You will make a difference by shaping the innovation pipeline, lead cross-functional teams, and work closely with Medical Affairs, R&D, Regulatory, Market Access, Sales, Finance, Operations, Zones and key markets to deliver growth, strengthen portfolio performance and bring meaningful solutions to patients, healthcare professionals and caregivers. This is a unique opportunity to lead a strategically important therapeutic area with significant business scope, including Inflammatory Bowel Diseases, while contributing to innovation concepts and launch readiness aligned with market needs.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Marketing Lead Inflammatory Bowel Diseases & Modulen® Brand Lead

• Leading the global strategy for Inflammatory Bowel Diseases to strengthen Nestlé’s relevance with patients, healthcare professionals and caregivers.

• Providing global leadership for Modulen® as a differentiated, science-led brand through clear positioning, strong claims and compelling communication.

• Driving innovation from insight to launch readiness by translating patient, customer, payer, product and competitor needs into meaningful growth opportunities.

• Shaping global activation plans, product value stories and launch materials that help markets deliver with confidence and consistency.

• Partnering across markets and functions to unlock insights, accelerate best-practice sharing and improve commercial execution.

jobs.title: Senior Technician in Analytical Chemistry
jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As a Senior Technician in Analytical Chemistry at Nestlé Research, your mission is to develop and manage analytical methods that support food compliance, chemical contaminant risk assessment, and risk mitigation. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with team and project members, technical services, analytical groups, business partners, quality teams, technology providers, and external suppliers. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Technician in Analytical Chemistry

• Developing analytical methods that strengthen food safety, compliance, and chemical contaminant risk assessment.

• Managing advanced laboratory equipment to deliver reliable data and high-quality analytical results.

• Driving method validation, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement in line with quality standards.

• Supporting technical assistance to markets and partners with practical recommendations and robust troubleshooting.

• Contributing to scientific reports, laboratory procedures, publications, and clear communication of analytical outcomes.

• Coaching apprentices and students while sharing technical knowledge across teams and working areas.

• Ensuring good laboratory practices, and promoting a mindset of safety in the laboratory

What will make you successful

• Bringing a background in analytical chemistry, such as a CFC, HES, Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent qualification.

• Applying hands-on industrial experience in analytical chemistry to deliver reliable methods, results, and technical support.

• Using strong expertise in liquid chromatography and gas chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry techniques, including related instruments and software.

• Applying assessment of rapid methods (e.g. lateral-flow assays) against method requirements

• Collaborating proactively across teams, taking initiative, staying well organized, and contributing to a positive team environment.

• Communicating proficiently in English and in French, especially in reading and writing.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen gestalten

Als Community Manager bei Nestlé Research besteht Ihre Mission darin, das Engagement, die Zugehörigkeit und die Verbindung zwischen Nestlé Research und der breiteren Forschungs- und Entwicklungsgemeinschaft zu stärken. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Mitarbeitern, Führungskräften, Websites, Funktionen und Gemeinschaften zusammenarbeiten.

Wie Sie als Community Manager etwas bewirken können

• Stärkung des Engagements und der Zugehörigkeit der Mitarbeiter durch sinnvolle Initiativen, die Menschen über Standorte und Gemeinschaften hinweg verbinden.

• Erstellen Sie ansprechende Kommunikationsmomente, Kampagnen, Veranstaltungen und digitale Inhalte, die zur Teilnahme und zum gemeinsamen Zweck inspirieren.

• Gespräche erleichtern und komplexe Themen in klare, zugängliche Botschaften übersetzen, die Verständnis und Dynamik schaffen.

• Bereitstellung von Initiativen mit Struktur, Kreativität und Qualität, um sichtbare Auswirkungen für Mitarbeiter und die Organisation zu erzielen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Mitbringen von starker Erfahrung in den Bereichen Mitarbeiterengagement, interne Kommunikation, Community-Management, Veranstaltungen oder verwandte Community-Building-Felder.

• Anwendung von Kreativität, Storytelling und digitalen Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um ansprechende Formate, Kampagnen und Inhalte zu entwerfen.

• Mit starken Projektmanagement- und Organisationsfähigkeiten mehrere Initiativen parallel zu Qualität und Wirkung zu liefern.

• vertrauensvoll mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Führungskräften, zusammenarbeiten und gleichzeitig mit Diplomatie und einer lösungsorientierten Denkweise beeinflussen.

• Fließend Englisch kommunizieren; Französischkenntnisse sind ein starker Vorteil.

• Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise, um gemeinsame Werte zu schaffen.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Comment vous aurez un impact en tant que gestionnaire communautaire

• Renforcer l'engagement et l'appartenance des employés grâce à des initiatives significatives qui relient les gens à l'échelle des sites et des collectivités.

• Créer des moments de communication stimulants, des campagnes, des événements et des contenus numériques qui inspirent la participation et l'objectif partagé.

• Faciliter les conversations et traduire des sujets complexes en messages clairs et accessibles qui favorisent la compréhension et l'élan.

• Mettre en oeuvre des initiatives de structure, de créativité et de qualité afin de créer un impact visible pour les employés et l'organisation.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide expérience dans l'engagement des employés, les communications internes, la gestion communautaire, les événements ou les domaines connexes de renforcement communautaire.

• Appliquer la créativité, la narration et la communication numérique pour concevoir des formats, des campagnes et des contenus engageants.

• Utiliser des compétences solides en gestion de projet et en organisation pour réaliser plusieurs initiatives en parallèle avec la qualité et l'impact.

• Collaborer en toute confiance avec divers intervenants, y compris les dirigeants, tout en influençant la diplomatie et l'esprit axé sur la solution.

Chez Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons

jobs.title: R&D Packaging Development Intern
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Start Date: January/February 2027
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Deadline for applications: 14 October 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As an R&D Packaging Development Intern at Nestlé Product Technology Centre (NPTC), your mission is to support the renovation of the Nescafé Dolce Gusto capsule body and contribute to the industrialization of the NEO SACHET 2030 project. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with packaging, quality assurance and system performance teams, as well as packaging material suppliers and external partners. This is your opportunity to gain hands-on experience in packaging innovation while working on a strategic sustainability and industrialization project.

How you’ll make an impact as an R&D Packaging Development Intern

• Support the renovation of the Nescafé Dolce Gusto capsule body by contributing to packaging material evaluation, testing and documentation

• Contribute to the industrialization of the NEO SACHET 2030 project through laboratory work, pilot trials and supplier or factory testing activities

• Collaborate with packaging, quality assurance and system performance teams to ensure packaging solutions meet technical, quality and sustainability expectations

• Prepare clear presentations, test reports and technical summaries to support project decisions and stakeholder alignment

• Interact with packaging material suppliers and external partners to follow up on trials, results and next steps in an agile project environment

What will make you successful

• Fresh graduate or current student in Materials Science, Packaging, Mechanical Engineering or a related field

• Interest in packaging development, sustainable materials, industrialization and hands-on testing in an R&D environment

• Good communication skills, attention to detail, curiosity and the ability to work proactively with cross-functional teams

• Strong data analytics skills, with the ability to interpret test results and translate data into clear insights. Previous experience on SPSS software is a plus

• Solid command of the MS Office Suite, especially Excel for data analysis

• Fluency in English; knowledge of French is an advantage

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.
